title: BEING BUSY IN CRYPTO DOESN'T MEAN YOU'RE MAKING PROGRESS.
subTitle:
Checking charts all day. Jumping from one coin to another. Following every breaking-news post. Joining every new Telegram group. Making trade after trade. It can feel like you're making progress. But ask yourself:
🧠 WHAT ARE YOU ACTUALLY LEARNING?
Real progress can look much quieter.
1️⃣ You understand your risks better.
2️⃣ You stop entering trades you don't understand.
3️⃣ You become less affected by FOMO.
4️⃣ You keep records of your decisions and learn from mistakes.
5️⃣ You become comfortable saying, “I don't know yet.”
That's progress too.
🔑 REMEMBER: More activity does not automatically mean better results. Sometimes progress means doing less, but making better-informed decisions. You don't need to chase every opportunity. You don't need to know every coin. You don't need to trade every day.
Learn. Observe. Reflect. Improve.
Then act when you have a reason to act.
💬 COMMUNITY QUESTION
Which one are you currently working on?
A. Understanding risk
B. Controlling FOMO
C. Learning before investing
D. Keeping records of my decisions
E. Being patient
Drop your letter below. 👇
Let's keep learning together.

The first thing after the European session opens—and it’s getting dominated by the Middle East again.

Three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked. Trump says on one hand that he “completely controls the strait,” and on the other threatens Iran with “talk or be bombed.” Oil prices jumped straight up—Brent touched 99 dollars. The US is also pressuring France and Germany to release strategic diesel reserves; if they don’t, it threatens a ban on exports. This script is getting more and more surreal.

What’s even tougher is the debt market: US 10-year yields surged 87 basis points in Q3, the worst quarter since 1994. TLT slid to a historical low. Real yields are nearing 3%, and for non-interest-bearing assets like $BTC $ETH , this is real, direct extraction. Gold holds above 4150—safe-haven capital still prefers gold first.

My take: In the short term, geopolitical conflict is just noise in the headlines—interest rates are the real lifeline for $BTC . If real yields don’t turn back, any rebound will have to be discounted. Iran says it received a new seven-day ceasefire proposal from the US; before the “boot” drops, don’t go all-in betting on direction. Volatility will only keep increasing.

Hold your hands—staying alive is stronger than anything.

📰 Why did Uphold suddenly offer token inheritance services? $331B estate gap sparks a niche race

Uphold has announced an optional token inheritance service for users, aiming to solve the problem of deceased people and their families being unable to trade cryptocurrencies. According to Bitcoin.com, the new service can help people address the issue of $33.1 billion in crypto assets being “left to rot” due to death or the inability to find account private keys. Now users can arrange for their families to sell BTC or XRP on their behalf for $19.99 per month.

Why is this news important?
The core reason is the legal “gap” in cryptocurrency “digital inheritance.” Traditional asset inheritance can follow paths like will notarization, but crypto is essentially code—no one can force the blockchain to “freeze” it so that a specific person can trade. By acting as an intermediary between law and the blockchain, Uphold’s service effectively creates a bridge where none existed. This means the industry is being forced to confront an uncomfortable pain point that people don’t want to talk about: “How do digital assets pass to the next generation?” In an environment where regulators still aren’t sure whether tokens are currency or securities, this pragmatic kind of innovation may actually find room to survive.

Impact on the market
In the short term, demand for BTC and XRP could be catalyzed, because the $33.1B gap is a real, existing source of potential incremental demand. But the long-term impact may be even bigger—if the service can solve the “inheritance loop” for tokens, it could reduce the average person’s impression that “crypto is a money-burning game,” and attract more traditional wealth holders. For example, if you invest in BTC now, could it change your holding logic if you can legally let your grandson inherit it? Historical parallel: the trust industry also developed back then partly because it solved the complexity of intergenerational wealth transfer for the wealthy.

Trading ideas
💡 This news could be a sentiment catalyst for ETH, but BTC is worth watching more. That’s because inheritance demand is inherently long-term. BTC’s status as “digital gold” could be reinforced as this use case becomes reality. But if XRP regulation tightens again, that logic would no longer hold.

Ethereum fund outflows concentrated｜Two Grayscale products total $33 million｜Around 2690 I’ll wait to confirm

My stance is cautious, but I don’t directly translate a fund’s daily outflow into an immediate expectation of ETH going down continuously. Farside’s daily flow table for U.S. spot Ethereum funds on September 30 shows total net outflows of about $59.6 million. Of this, Grayscale ETHE saw net outflows of $7.5 million, while the Grayscale mini fund for ETH saw net outflows of $25.5 million (code: ETH). Together, the two amount to $33 million, about 55% of that day’s total net outflows. In addition, FETH recorded net outflows of $26.6 million, and ETHA showed 0.0 for the day. 

This structure is more useful than looking at a single total: the pressure isn’t evenly distributed across products, and you can’t conclude that institutions have broadly turned to net buying just because one large product is at zero.

I’m especially careful about an easy-to-misread point: the fee rates of Grayscale’s two products differ a lot. The product materials in SEC filings state that ETHE’s management fee rate is 2.50% annualized, while the mini fund ETH is 0.15% annualized. Long-term cost can influence holders’ choices, but on September 30 both products recorded net outflows—so you can’t invent a story that the same day’s capital “moved from ETHE to ETH” just because one has a lower fee. Fund net flows reflect the net amount of subscriptions and redemptions; they do not equal all trading activity on exchange, and they also do not equal spot ETH buy/sell volumes at a single moment. To verify whether money is flowing back, I’ll look at the net flows over subsequent days and whether multiple products improve at the same time, rather than grabbing one day and drawing a definite conclusion.

The mechanism this implies for the crypto market is: when funds are continuously redeemed, hedging in the primary market and inventory adjustments may put pressure on spot’s ability to absorb demand. But if redemptions are just a one-day portfolio rebalancing, price may quickly move away from the flow direction. Both scenarios require confirmation from both price and follow-up subscriptions/redemptions. 

When I checked Binance ETHUSDT around $2689.8, it was up about 0.44% over 24 hours, with an intraday high around $2738.5 and a low around $2667.9. This is the fact that ETH maintained a small intraday gain despite the outflow background—it doesn’t prove that the fund data is invalid, and it doesn’t prove price changes are driven solely by the fund.

For the short term, I’m watching whether $2670 can hold, whether price can regain and stand firm around $2720, and $2738 as an upside test level. If it breaks below $2667 and the rebound can’t get back, that would invalidate my view that we’ll see a consolidation followed by an upside attempt. Only if it sustains above $2738 will it indicate buyers have more convincing strength.

If I were trading for myself, I would not participate right now and I wouldn’t chase a breakout. I’d only consider a lightly sized, long-biased position in unleveraged ETH spot: wait for the one-hour close to regain above $2720; then if it pulls back to the $2705–$2715 zone without breaking, I would place a test order using no more than 0.3% of total capital. First target: $2745—reduce by half on touch. Second target: around $2780—close the remaining in batches. Initial stop loss set at $2680. If after entry, the two-hour close falls back below $2705, I’d voluntarily close the position. If it breaks below $2667 before any trigger, I’ll cancel the long plan rather than add during a decline. 

What the fund structure gives me is a risk warning—what ultimately determines the trade is later data together with price confirmation.

Source: Farside Ethereum fund daily flow data, SEC filings’ materials for two Grayscale fund products, and Binance ETHUSDT price action. #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH基金流出集中｜灰度两只合计3300万美元｜2690附近我先等确认

我的态度是偏谨慎，但不把基金单日流出直接翻译成ETH要连续下跌。Farside的9月30日美国现货以太坊基金逐日表显示，全组净流出约5960万美元；其中灰度ETHE净流出750万美元，代码为ETH的灰度迷你基金净流出2550万美元，两只合计3300万美元，约占当日净流出的55%。另外FETH净流出2660万美元，ETHA当日显示0.0。这样的结构比只看一个总数更有用：压力不是所有产品平均分担，也不能因为一只大型产品为零就说机构全面转多。

我特别注意一个容易误读的地方：灰度这两只产品费率差很大。SEC存档的产品材料写明，ETHE管理费率为年化2.50%，迷你基金ETH为年化0.15%。长期成本会影响持有者选择，但9月30日两只产品都录得净流出，不能拿“低费率”编出当天资金已经从ETHE搬到ETH的故事。基金净流量反映申购赎回的净额，不等于所有场内成交，也不等于同一时点的现货ETH买卖额。要验证资金是否回流，我会看后续多日净流量和多个产品是否同时改善，而不是抓住一天给出确定结论。

这件事影响加密市场的机制是：基金持续被赎回时，一级市场的对冲及库存调整可能让现货承接面临压力；若赎回只是单日组合再平衡，价格又可能很快脱离流量方向。两种情况都需要价格和后续申赎共同确认。我查看币安ETHUSDT时约2689.8美元，24小时涨约0.44%，日内高约2738.5、低约2667.9。这是基金流出背景下仍维持日内小幅上涨的事实，不证明基金数据无效，也不能证明价格涨跌由基金独自驱动。短线我看2670附近能否守住，2720附近能否重新站稳，2738附近是上方测试位。跌破2667且反抽不回，会推翻我对盘整后上探的判断；持续站上2738，才说明买盘更有说服力。

如果是我自己交易，当前先不参与，不做追涨单。只考虑无杠杆ETH现货轻仓偏多：等一小时收盘重新站上2720，随后回踩2705至2715不破，才用总资金最多0.3%试单。第一目标2745，触及先减半；第二目标2780附近，剩余分批平仓。初始止损设在2680；若入场后两小时收盘再落回2705下方，也主动平仓。若触发前先跌破2667，我会取消多单计划，而不是在下跌中补仓。基金结构给我的是风险提示，真正决定交易的是后续数据与价格共同确认。

来源：Farside以太坊基金逐日流量、SEC存档的灰度两只基金产品材料、币安ETHUSDT行情。#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

【ETH Drawdown from ATH: It’s Not a “Buy-the-Dip” Signal—It’s a Battle for Pricing Power】

ETH has fallen nearly half from its highs. How should we look at this?

Here’s my judgment: a 45% pullback from the ATH range really is a value zone that long-term funds start to pay attention to. But “attention” doesn’t mean “it will rise right away”—these are very different.

What’s happening in the market right now is this—sentiment is elevated, but the order book isn’t pushing higher. FGI is 74, which is greedy territory, yet price has been grinding around $ 2685 and can’t move up. This is the most ominous signal. I’ve seen this so many times: when sentiment hits a peak but the market stalls, what usually comes next isn’t a big breakout—it’s a turning point.

Another detail: on Tuesday, Ether ETFs saw outflows of 3 million, ending a streak of seven consecutive days of net inflows. Funds are coming in, but what are they coming in for? It’s probably short-term positioning. Can it last? Hard to say.

So what does this, in practice, mean?

If ETF funds come in, it indicates institutions are reconfiguring their exposure to ETH—that’s a good thing. But the question is—are institutions buying “ETH as a digital asset” as a label, or do they genuinely believe in the real-world applications on the ETH chain? If it’s only the former, then after this wave of gains, you may still end up with a mess.

MetaMask has recently been investigating security incidents, and zk.money is relaunching for privacy payments after three years—what do these things suggest? The ETH ecosystem is actively running in the real world—people are using it, and people are solving problems. That’s the true foundation for ETH’s long-term value. Price can be traded, but real on-chain usage can’t be faked.

So my view:

Support is at $ 2640–$ 2650, with the more important support at $ 2580. $ 2750 is the near-term pivot between bulls and bears. Only after a breakout and hold can we look for the next move.

The market has been moving sideways here for almost a week—the direction is about to show itself. I lean toward waiting for the signal rather than guessing here. 【ETH从ATH回撤45%：不是抄底信号，是定价权的博弈】

ETH从高位跌了将近一半，这事怎么看？

我讲个判断：从ATH回撤45%这个区间，确实是历史上长线资金开始关注的价值区域。但"关注"不等于"马上涨"，这两件事差得远。

现在市场的实际情况是——情绪在高位，但盘面没有继续上攻。FGI 74，贪婪得很，可价格就在$ 2685附近磨，涨不动。这才是最要命的信号。我见过太多次了，情绪高潮但盘面停滞，接下来往往不是大涨，是变盘。

还有个细节：Ether ETFs周二流出300万，结束了连续7天的净流入。ETF资金进来了，但进来干什么？短线博弈的还是多。能持续吗？不好说。

那这件事落到实处意味着什么？

ETF资金进来，说明机构在重新配置ETH这块资产，这是好事。但问题在于——机构进来买的是"ETH作为数字资产"这个标签，还是真的看好ETH链上的实际应用？如果只是前者，那这波涨完了还是一地鸡毛。

MetaMask最近在查安全事件，zk.money三年后重新上线做隐私支付——这些事说明什么？ETH生态在实际跑，有人在用，有人在解决问题。这才是ETH长期价值真正的地基。价格可以炒，但链上真实使用量骗不了人。

所以我的判断：

支撑看$ 2640-$ 2650，重要支撑在$ 2580。$ 2750是短期多空分水岭，突破站稳才能看下一波。

盘面在这里横了快一周了，方向快出了。我倾向于等信号，不在这里猜。放量突破$ 2750，短线跟进；跌破$ 2640，管住手。这中间的位置，不做不算错。

**$ETH  K-line is telling a story unrelated to narrative**

For now, put aside terms like "hacker funds settling" and "L2 liquidity gathering"—just look at the chart: $ETH  current price is 2680.04, up 0.47% in the past 24 hours, with volume of 830 million USDT—about half of BTC’s volume, while ETH’s market-cap share is far more than that proportion. A slight rise on contracting volume indicates that this is consolidation from buyers absorbing and holding the order book, not incremental chasing.

Structurally, after ETH’s low around the 2500 area was lifted, it has been moving in an uptrend channel with a low slope. The K-line bodies are small and the wicks are long—typical of turnover-driven consolidation rather than trend acceleration. The funding rate is 0.0053%, the highest among the three major ones, and higher than BTC’s 0.0039%. Bulls are willing to pay a premium, but price hasn’t moved in proportion to that capacity—this is a sign of crowded longs rather than strong longs. With the sentiment reading of 74’s greed stacked on top of this funding rate, the short-term risk-reward for chasing longs isn’t great.

On relative strength, $ETH ’s daily gain slightly outperforms BTC, but volume hasn’t kept up. That suggests it’s currently more like a "follower": when BTC tests 84.2K–85K, ETH’s beta contracts rather than leading. To turn ETH into the leader, you’d need to see a breakout with volume above the previous high-dense zone of 2760–2780. Below, 2610 is the failure level of this upswing structure; a closing break below it would damage the channel and likely pull price back to retest the lower edge of the range.

In terms of trading, keep position sizing within a loss you can bear per trade—no more than 1% of principal. If the failure level breaks, cut the position; there’s no need to amplify directional judgment with leverage. The current price action of $ETH  is "gentle upward, longs somewhat crowded," not "building up for a breakout."

#ETH #价格行为 #资金费率 #crypto trading

content:
**$ETH 的 K 线在讲一个和叙事无关的故事**

把"黑客资金沉淀""L2 流动性汇聚"这些说法先放一边，只看盘面：$ETH 现价 2680.04，24 小时 +0.47%，成交 8.3 亿 USDT——大约是 BTC 成交量的一半，而 ETH 市值占比远不止这个比例。缩量微涨，说明这里是承接盘在托，不是增量在追。

结构上，ETH 自 2500 一带的低点抬升后，走的是低斜率上升通道，K 线实体小、影线长，典型的换手型盘整而非趋势推进。资金费率 0.0053%，是三个主流里最高的，且高于 BTC 的 0.0039%——多头愿意付溢价，但价格没走出对应的空间，这是多头拥挤而非多头强势的信号。情绪 74 的贪婪读数叠加这个费率，短线追多的性价比并不好。

相对强度上，$ETH 日涨幅略胜 BTC，但成交量没有跟上，说明它现在更像"跟随者"：BTC 在 84.2K–85K 试探时，ETH 的 beta 收缩，而非领涨。若要 ETH 转为领先，需要看到放量突破 2760–2780 这个前高密集区；下方 2610 是本轮抬升结构的失效位，收盘跌破则通道破坏，回到区间下沿测试。

操作上，仓位控制在可承受单笔 1% 本金损失以内，失效位破位即减，不用杠杆放大方向判断。$ETH 现在的价格行为是"温和上行、多头偏挤"，不是"蓄势待发"。

Core PCE YoY at 3.0% | Real consumption up 0.6% QoQ | ETH around 2680—wait first

My stance is to stand by: inflation readings are relatively mild, so you can’t jump straight to “easing is already settled”; consumption still shows resilience, so you also can’t label this data as an economic downturn. The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis’ personal income and spending report released on September 30 (for August) is very clear: the core PCE price index excluding food and energy rose 3.0% year over year and 0.2% month over month; real personal consumption expenditures increased 0.6% month over month, and nominal consumer spending increased 0.9% month over month. Here, 3.0% is the year-over-year price growth, while 0.6% is the month-over-month change in consumption volume adjusted for prices—different measures, so you can’t subtract them to derive some so-called “real interest rate.”

How does this affect ETH? The market prices risk assets through future policy interest rates, U.S. Treasury yields, and dollar liquidity. Easing price pressure may reduce discount-rate concerns, but stronger-than-expected consumption also implies demand hasn’t cooled meaningfully, so the central bank may not be willing to give an immediately sustainable easing commitment. For an asset like ETH, which is influenced simultaneously by macro liquidity, ETF creations/redemptions, and on-chain demand, the macro direction is only one line. I’d rather see confirmation from both capital flows and spot prices. Farside’s September 30 table for ETH spot fund holdings shows net outflows of $59.6 million, with FETH, ETHE, and Grayscale’s mini fund all negative. That doesn’t match the simplistic narrative that “mild inflation means you must buy ETH right away,” but it also can’t prove that fund outflows were caused by PCE alone.

How has the market reacted? When I wrote this, Binance ETH/USDT was around 2681.51, with a 24-hour rolling high of 2738.51 and a low of 2665.00—and it still hasn’t reclaimed the upper band. Binance Square’s #USCorePCEEasesTo3%InAugust is a hot-board item directly related to this topic, but the title’s “down to 3%” doesn’t mean the Federal Reserve has decided to cut rates. My key levels are defense around 2665, a short-term reclaim at 2700, and the prior high around 2738. If price holds 2700 and then breaks back above 2738, and if subsequent fund creations/redemptions improve, then I would cautiously revise upward. If it breaks below 2665, I’ll temporarily cancel the bounce assumption. Especially, you can’t treat the 24-hour rolling percentage change as an independent reaction after data release—that would blur the time window.

If it were me trading: I wouldn’t participate now; I’m only preparing to go long on unleveraged spot. Only if the one-hour closing price holds above 2700, then retests 2690 to 2700 without breaking, and the exchange deposits/withdrawals are confirmed normal, would I put in at most 0.4% of total capital. First target: 2725 (take half off). Second target: 2738 to 2750 (scale out in batches). Entering, a hard stop-loss at 2672. Even if the stop isn’t hit, if two consecutive one-hour closes reclaim, then I exit if price is back below 2690. If it breaks below 2665 before triggering, the entire plan is void—I won’t add to average down. Both macro data and fund data could be revised; what you can truly control is position sizing and exit conditions—not speculation about central bank remarks or a single day’s net flow.

Data sources: U.S. BEA August personal income and spending release, Farside ETH ETF daily table on September 30, Binance ETH/USDT price action and Binance Square hot board. The data represent different times and market contexts, and do not support a single-cause attribution.

📰 Why is the Aave DAO borrowing $50M to institutions? Crypto-collateralized lending: a new trend with how much room to grow?

The Aave DAO wants to make a big move—planning to borrow up to $50M from institutions with large amounts of capital. The catch is that these institutions must use Bitcoin or Ether as collateral. In simple terms, Aave will provide loans to institutions, but the funds first come from borrowing stablecoins in the market, and then those crypto assets are used as collateral. Of course, this has risks. Even if the institutions repay, Aave’s own collateral could still get stuck.

Why is this news important?
Aave is trying a new approach and wants a big slice of the crypto-collateralized lending “pie.” You know that the entire DeFi market is currently trying to figure out how to attract large capital and big institutions, and Aave is the industry leader. With such a large loan amount this time, it suggests they believe crypto-collateralized lending is a solid direction. And using a DAO to do it also makes the process feel especially transparent. If it works, it could lead more large players to start trusting DeFi—after all, Aave has a great reputation worldwide. In plain terms, this is a major milestone in the crypto world: such a large-scale initiative by a DAO.

Impact on the market
In the short term, this may improve sentiment in the crypto market, since Aave is a big name and doing this amounts to an endorsement for the whole industry. For BTC and ETH, if the plan is implemented smoothly, it could make these coins more attractive to institutions in the near term. But in the long run, the key is whether these loans trigger risks—such as a sharp drop in collateral value or Aave facing tight liquidity. Historically, similar events are not very common, but P2P credit risk has always been a sword hanging overhead.

Trading/strategy ideas
💡 I think this is positive for the crypto-collateralized lending sector, but in the short term the direct impact on BTC and ETH may be limited. If Aave can execute the plan smoothly and avoid risks, it could boost the market’s confidence in crypto collateral. But I pulled the data, and the conclusion is: this view is invalid if Aave itself gets trapped in collateral first. After all, their model explicitly acknowledges this risk.

Aave这是在玩个新花样，想从加密抵押贷款这块分一块大蛋糕。要知道现在整个DeFi市场都在琢磨怎么吸引大钱大机构，而Aave是龙头老大。他们这次搞这么大的贷款额度，意味着他们认为加密抵押贷款是个靠谱的方向。而且他们用DAO来做这件事，还显得特别透明。如果这能成，可能让更多大钱开始信任DeFi，毕竟Aave在全球有口皆碑。说白了，这是加密世界里头回有DAO这么大规模干这个，意义重大。

对市场的影响
短期内，这事儿可能会让加密货币市场情绪更好，毕竟Aave是大牌子，他们这么干，等于给整个行业背书。对BTC和ETH来说，如果这个计划顺利实施，可能会让这两个币在短期内更受机构青睐。但长期看，关键在于这些贷款会不会引发风险，比如抵押品价值暴跌或者Aave自己资金链紧张。历史上类似事件不多，但P2P信贷风险一直是悬在空中的剑。

操作思路
💡 我认为这个消息利好加密抵押贷款赛道，但短期内对BTC和ETH的直接影响有限。如果Aave能顺利执行这个计划，并且没出风险，可能会让市场对加密抵押品更有信心。但我拉了数据，结论是：如果Aave自己先被抵押品套牢，这个判断作废。毕竟他们这次的模型里就承认了这个风险。

Stripe has announced that its corporate payments business has fully switched to Open USD (OUSD) as the default stablecoin. This means that when global merchants and businesses make cross-border transactions, funds can move quickly and at low cost—just like dollars—without needing to be converted into various currencies. This is great news for international businesses that rely on the U.S. dollar, but it introduces uncertainty for the tokenized payments landscape in crypto.

Why is this news important?
Stripe is one of the largest payment processors in the world, and its choices directly influence how business customers act. This is not a random stablecoin pick. Stripe is using Open USD, a U.S. dollar stablecoin supported by the Central Bank Digital Currency Research Institute (CBDC R&D). That means:
1. Businesses no longer need to rely on third-party stablecoins like Tether, reducing the risk of funds being misappropriated
2. Cross-border transactions can bypass traditional banking systems, improving efficiency by more than 80% (official data)
3. Crypto payments are starting to move from individual consumer use cases into the enterprise B2B battleground

Market impact
In the short term, this could boost sentiment in the stablecoin sector, but it may not necessarily be favorable for crypto-native assets like ETH. That’s because Stripe is using a USD stablecoin, not an Ethereum stablecoin. This implies:
- BTC may receive support, since demand for USD-denominated assets remains strong
- ETH may face near-term pressure, because there hasn’t been a clear breakthrough in B2B application scenarios
- OUSD-like stablecoins backed by central banks may take some share away from Tether, but fundamentally they are still substitutes for the U.S. dollar

The GENIUS bill is attracting attention because it is not merely amending existing laws; it aims to establish a complete “walled garden” system in the stablecoin space. This means that any on-chain activity involving USD stablecoins would need to operate within this new framework. Why does this matter? Simply put, the industry’s track is being set in advance. Like driving onto a highway: you can’t speed, but at least you know the direction. For capital, this lowers uncertainty costs.

What does this mean?
For investors, it suggests that over the next few years the crypto market may take on a “stable with order” pattern. The old “wild growth” style of play may no longer be feasible, which is bad news for those who like innovation but take very high risks. But for overall market stability, it may not be a bad thing. If the bill passes, I would pay more attention to on-chain projects that can adapt to the new regulatory framework—such as DeFi protocols that have already gone through compliance channels. 这意味着什么？对投资者而言，就是未来几年加密市场可能会呈现出"稳中有序"的格局。过去那种"野蛮生长"的玩法可能玩不起了，这对那些喜欢创新但风险极高的项目来说是个坏消息，但对市场整体稳定来说，未必是坏事。如果A16z说得没错，这确实可能让链上转移形成永久趋势。

对市场的影响
短期来看，这条新闻可能更多是情绪层面的影响。毕竟法案还没通过，只是即将投票。但考虑到A16z的行业地位，这条表态足够让市场开始认真思考监管环境可能发生的变化。对BTC和ETH的影响，更多体现在长期资金配置的倾向上。如果监管环境真的趋于稳定，可能会吸引一部分传统资金进入，但短期内不太可能直接推动价格大幅上涨。

从格局上看，如果GENIUS法案通过，可能会加速全球各国形成类似监管体系。毕竟美国是加密货币的主要市场之一，如果这里都开始严格管了，其他国家大概率也得跟上。这对中国这种试图在监管中寻求创新的国家来说，意味着更大的政策协调难度。资金流向方面，可能会出现从监管宽松地区向监管明确地区转移的现象。

历史上类似事件可以参考2019年的欧洲加密货币市场法规（Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation），当时也是通过一系列新规，让整个市场的运作变得更加规范。但那次的影响相对分散，而GENIUS法案是专门针对稳定币领域的，影响可能更集中。

操作思路
💡 简单说：我认为短期内不会立刻改变市场方向，但长期看，稳定的监管环境对成熟市场是有利的。如果法案通过，我会更关注那些能够适应新监管框架的链上项目，比如那些已经通过合规通道的DeFi协议。但这个判断如果BTC跌破$80K，或者出现新的重大黑客攻击事件，就会立刻失效。

以太坊当前报价两千七百一十六点三九美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之二点一，表现优于比特币。价格从两千六百六十二美元起步，在买盘推动下逐步攀升至两千七百一十七美元，整体呈现稳步上涨态势。

从小时线数据来看，以太坊在过去五个交易小时内保持连续上涨，每个小时都录得正收益，显示出较强的上涨动能。成交量方面，上涨时段成交额维持在两千万美元以上，表明资金流入较为稳定。

二、技术指标解读

技术指标显示以太坊短期处于强势状态，但已出现超买信号。在十五个量化因子中，六个因子发出看多信号，八个因子发出看空信号，一个因子保持中性，综合指标偏向看空方向，这与价格的强势表现形成一定背离。

MACD指标表现强劲，MACD线、信号线和柱状图均处于正值区域且持续扩张。最新数据显示MACD值为五点八零七，信号线为二点二零五，柱状图达到三点六零二，显示上涨动能仍在增强。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪受到多重利好因素支撑。首先，代币化和稳定币扩张为以太坊网络带来实质性利好。美国证券交易委员会为代币化股票提供五年豁免期，加上Open USD流动性联盟的成立，大幅提升了以太坊网络的实用价值和吸引力。

衍生品市场的创新也为以太坊带来增量资金。新推出的永续合约产品提供最高十倍杠杆，扩大了零售和机构投资者的参与渠道，尾盘买盘的增强正是这一产品创新带来的直接效果。现货市场净流入转正，配合看涨的MACD柱状图扩张，推动以太坊完成从两千六百六十二美元到两千七百一十七美元的突破。

然而，市场风险不容忽视。MetaMask安全事件导致验证者退出，引发市场对质押以太坊安全性的担忧。质押基础设施的漏洞可能影响投资者信心，进而影响以太坊的质押率和网络安全。

技术面超买信号明显，短期RSI达到七十九点五并触及布林带上轨两千七百二十一美元，均值回归风险上升。美国现货以太坊ETF在连续七天净流入后出现五千九百六十万美元的净流出，机构资金动能有所减弱。

投资者在关注以太坊上涨机会的同时，需要密切关注质押安全风险和技术面回调压力，合理设置止损位，控制投资风险。

The Bank of Japan’s late-October meeting date is confirmed｜Trading desks warn about the risk of unwinding carry trades｜ETH near 2720, I’m not betting on a rate hike

My stance is cautious—watch for a rebound—but I’m putting “a possible unexpected rate hike by the BOJ” on the risk checklist, not treating it as a given policy. The BOJ’s official schedule lists the next monetary policy decision meeting as being on October 29–30. The decision and the outlook report will only be released after the meeting. Binance OTC’s weekly observation published today suggests that if an unexpected rate hike occurs in late October, carry trades funded in yen could shrink, and well-liquid high-volatility assets would feel pressure first. This is a scenario from the trading desk, not a disclosure of a decision by the central bank, and it doesn’t mean ETH must fall right now.

The key point of this topic isn’t forecasting the exact level of Japan’s interest rates—it’s the sequence of capital transmission. Positions that borrow low-interest yen, swap into dollars, and hold risk assets may trigger the simultaneous selling of assets and buying back yen when the yen strengthens or borrowing costs rise. ETH has its own demand drivers—spot funds, staking, and on-chain ecosystem activity—but in moments when risk needs to be reduced quickly, higher-liquidity and all-day trading can push it into a faster, passive de-risking basket. Therefore, if the yen tightens in the same direction as global long-end yields near the meeting date, focusing only on the “Ethereum upgrade narrative” would miss external pressure. And if the BOJ maintains policy as expected, the so-called “carry-trade shock” may not happen at all.

The market is not pricing “the risk has already materialized” right now. When querying Binance ETHUSDT, ETH is about $2,719.71, up around 1.74% over 24 hours, with a range low of $2,656.92 and a high of $2,738.51. This is just a price snapshot—it can’t be claimed that the rally is caused by the BOJ schedule. Farside’s Ethereum fund table for September 30 at the time showed a net outflow of $59.6 million in the total column, which also reminds me not to equate a spot rebound with institutions adding positions in sync. Data may be revised, so you can’t determine the medium-term trend based on a single day’s flows. Above the key levels are the intraday high near 2738 and 2760; below are 2700 and 2680. If it regains and holds 2738 and subsequent fund flows improve, I’ll overturn the short-term cautious view. If it breaks down below 2680 and fails to bounce back, the rebound thesis is invalidated.

If this were my own trade, I wouldn’t short in advance today, and I wouldn’t add leverage early for the end-of-month meeting. Directionally, I’d only consider spot long with a light position; the maximum per-trade capital limit is 2%. The entry trigger is either: after a pullback to 2700–2705, it reclaims 2720; or after breaking above 2738, it pulls back without breaking. Only one condition is executed. First target: reduce one-third at 2738. Second target: reduce another one-third at 2760. If going with the breakout plan, the first target becomes 2760 and the second target is around 2790. Stop-loss is placed below 2680. If it breaks below 2680, shows a breakdown with expanding volume, and fund flows continue to worsen, or if the BOJ officially releases an unexpectedly hawkish tightening signal, I’ll close the position and exit. Single-account risk is controlled within 0.3%. If no trigger occurs, I stay flat—I don’t turn assumptions into performance.

Source: BOJ official meeting schedule, Binance OTC October 1 weekly observation, Farside daily Ethereum fund data, Binance ETHUSDT market snapshot. #ETH

The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

日本央行10月底会议日期已定｜交易台提示套息平仓风险｜ETH在2720附近我不押注加息

我的态度是谨慎看反弹，但把“日央行可能意外加息”放在风险清单，不把它写成既定政策。日本央行官网日程列出下一次货币政策决定会议在10月29日至30日，决定和展望报告要到会后才会公布。币安OTC今天发布的周度观察认为，若10月底出现意外加息，日元融资的套息交易可能收缩，流动性好的高波动资产会先承压。这是交易台的条件情景，不是央行透露了决定，也不意味着ETH现在一定要跌。

我看这个题的重点不是预测日本利率点位，而是资金传导顺序。借低息日元、换成美元去持有风险资产的头寸，遇到日元走强或融资成本上升时，可能同时卖出资产和买回日元。ETH有现货基金、质押和链上生态等自身需求，但在需要迅速降风险的时刻，流动性高、全天交易反而会让它更快进入被动减仓篮子。因此，若临近会议日元与全球长端利率同向收紧，只盯着以太坊升级叙事会漏掉外部压力；若央行按预期维持政策，所谓“套息冲击”也可能根本不发生。

市场目前并未按“风险已落地”定价。币安ETHUSDT查询时约2719.71美元，24小时涨约1.74%，区间低点2656.92、高点2738.51；这只是价格快照，不能说涨幅由日本央行日程造成。Farside的9月30日以太坊基金表格当时显示总栏净流出5960万美元，也提醒我不要把现货反弹等同于机构同步加仓；数据可能修订，不能靠一日流量决定中期趋势。关键位上方是2738附近的日内高点和2760，下方是2700与2680。若重新站稳2738且后续基金资金改善，我会推翻短线谨慎；若失守2680并反抽失败，则反弹判断作废。

如果是我自己交易，今天不预先做空，更不为月底会议提前加杠杆；方向只考虑现货轻仓做多，单次资金上限2%。入场触发是回踩2700—2705后重新收回2720，或突破2738后回踩不破，只执行一个条件。第一目标2738减三分之一，第二目标2760再减三分之一；若走突破方案，第一目标改为2760、第二目标看2790。止损放在2680下方，若跌破2680、出现放量下破而基金流继续恶化，或央行正式释放超预期紧缩信号，就平仓退出。单次账户风险控制在0.3%以内；没有触发就空仓，不把假设写成战绩。

🤔 Why is AllUnity entering the compliant and stablecoin battlefield with bank backing? Will the $119.45K BTC and $2.7K ETH shake because of this?

AllUnity has obtained certification under the EU’s MiCA framework, and issued the USDAU stablecoin with a bank as guarantor. This isn’t a lone-wolf move—recently, the EU has tightened stablecoin regulation even more than the U.S., and now it has also written “bank participation” right into the game’s completion key. Traditional financial institutions suddenly realized: hey, this crypto can help me cut cross-border payment fees by half. So, in essence, AllUnity’s move is banks using crypto to strap rockets onto their own payment systems 🚀.

Why is this news important?
The key to AllUnity’s success this time is a double punch: “bank endorsement + EU compliance.” The EU’s MiCA framework is like a stamp of approval for cryptocurrencies, but it comes with a hidden requirement: it must be able to integrate seamlessly with the traditional financial system. Banks are willing to provide endorsement because the stablecoin can be directly converted into bank transaction records, solving the deadlock in crypto where it has “inflows but not outflows.” This means regulators no longer view stablecoins as an “underground money operation,” but instead bring them into the “regular army.” At a deeper level, this is a new track in the global race to digitize finance—banks want to use crypto to capture the cross-border payments value pool worth $316M.

Market impact
The birth of USDAU is expected to create at least three waves of impact:
1. For BTC/ETH short-term sentiment, it’s like throwing a “regulatory-positive bomb” into the crypto world. But the long-term trend depends on whether it can truly onboard bank customers. For now, as long as AllUnity can prove that “banks can conveniently use USDAU for international settlement,” BTC and ETH’s safe-haven attributes may actually be weakened. A historical reference to similar events: when Facebook tried to issue a stablecoin back then, the Bitcoin price actually rose by 30%—because regulatory concepts led the way first; once banks were actually brought in, market conditions had already changed.

💡 I believe bank-backed stablecoins are a new direction of certainty in crypto. If, next, we can see real data from the first deal where “bank corporate accounts complete euro settlement via USDAU,” USDAU could break above the $0.98 psychological level. But if it falls below $0.95, it would mean banks are only giving verbal support, and that view would be invalid.

Trading approach
If, in the next two weeks, EU regulators publicly praise AllUnity for “successfully integrating with traditional finance,” the $119.45K BTC may be just a transitional move. At this stage, the $2.7K ETH is more suitable as a “watching participant,” because it needs more bank-backed capital to break the current “technology-stock stagnation” market structure. The premise for this view is that traditional financial institutions will not reject USDAU just because “crypto has volatility.”

AllUnity拿到欧盟MiCA框架认证，用银行做担保发行了USDAU稳定币。这可不是孤狼行为——最近欧盟把稳定币监管搞到比美国还细，现在又把"银行参与"写成游戏通关密钥。传统金融机构突然发现：嘿，这加密货币能帮我把跨境支付手续费砍一半。所以AllUnity这波，本质是银行用加密货币给自家支付系统装火箭🚀。

为什么这条新闻重要？
AllUnity这次成功的关键在于"银行背书+欧盟合规"的双杀组合。欧盟的MiCA框架相当于给加密货币盖章认证，但这个框架有个隐藏要求：必须得跟传统金融体系能无缝对接。银行愿意做背书，是因为稳定币能直接变成银行流水，解决了加密货币"只有进没有出"的死结。这意味着，监管不再把稳定币当"地下钱庄"，而是纳入了"正规军编制"。更深层看，这是全球金融数字化竞赛中的新赛道——银行想用加密货币抢占跨境支付这块价值$316M的蛋糕。

对市场的影响
USDAU的诞生至少产生三波影响：
1. 对BTC/ETH的短期情绪看，相当于往加密货币世界里扔了颗"监管利好炸弹"。但长期趋势取决于它能不能真把银行客户接过来，目前看，只要AllUnity能证明"银行能方便地用USDAU做国际结算"，BTC和ETH的避险属性可能反而会被削弱。历史类似事件参考：当年Facebook想发稳定币时，比特币价格反而上涨了30%——都是合规概念在先，真把银行接进来时行情已经变了。

💡 我认为银行系稳定币是加密货币的新确定性方向。如果接下来能看到第一笔"银行对公账户通过USDAU完成欧元结算"的实单数据，USDAU可能突破$0.98这个心理价位。但跌破$0.95，说明银行只是口头支持，这个判断作废。

操作思路
如果未来两周看到欧盟监管机构公开表扬AllUnity"整合传统金融很成功"，$119.45K的BTC可能只是过渡行情。现阶段$2.7K的ETH更适合观察型选手，因为它需要更多银行系资金入场才能打破目前的"科技股滞涨"格局。这个判断的前提是，传统金融机构不会因为"加密货币有波动性"而拒绝USDAU。

📌 Why do many traders profit from small gains but suffer big losses?#BTC #ETH 
When I first entered the market, I always thought the problem was technical.
Later I realized most people’s issue isn’t that they don’t know how to buy—it’s that they don’t know how to hold winning trades, nor how to deal with losing trades.
Make 10% and worry the profits will give back—close immediately;
Lose 10% and keep thinking “just wait”—end up losing 50%.
Over the long run:
✅ Small profits
❌ Big losses
And the account naturally becomes harder and harder to manage.
A truly mature trading system isn’t about improving win rate—it’s about:
Letting profits run when you’re in the green,
Admitting mistakes quickly when you’re wrong.
The market never goes up because of your expectations, and it never reverses because you refuse to accept reality.
The essence of trading:
Not predicting the future,
but managing risk.
Same encouragement to all.

Markus Thielen (founder of 10x Research) says the latest takeaway is that understanding the reasons behind the rise in rates matters more than the rate level itself. For Bitcoin, which has no cash flows to support it, the negative drivers from Fed rate hikes are completely different from the negative drivers stemming from fiscal concerns.

Why is this news important?
The 10-year Treasury bond is known as the benchmark for the “risk-free rate.” Its trend acts like a seesaw that affects all risk assets. Currently, the market has two very different expectations:
1. **Fed-driven downside**: If yields rise because the Fed keeps tightening monetary policy, then a zero-coupon asset like Bitcoin could face pressure as safe-haven flows move out.
2. **Risk-premium-driven downside**: If yields rise because the market worries about fiscal deficits, inflation, or a surge in long-term bond risk premium (term premium), then Bitcoin could actually benefit, since it’s seen as a hedge against these macro risks.
Thielen’s core judgment is this: the first scenario is “systemic risk spillover,” while the second scenario is “risk appetite rotation.” The market currently mixes both factors, but the share of the latter may be increasing.

Impact on the market
This means investors can’t simply say “rates rising = Bitcoin falling.” The exact transmission path depends on where the money flows:
- **For BTC**: If Treasury yields rise mainly due to fiscal concerns, capital may rotate from Treasuries into non-standard assets like Bitcoin, supporting the price around $84,288. But once it’s confirmed that the driver is Fed-led tightening, the support level below $82,000 will need to be reassessed. South Korea is one of the most active crypto trading markets globally. Local capital is highly sensitive to these macro drivers—if domestic funds leave, it can directly create sell-pressure on BTC.
- **For ETH**: Ethereum benefits with slightly less sensitivity than BTC, because it still has staking rewards as support. But as long as the driver is Fed rate hikes, all risk assets will face pressure. If the regulatory environment continues to move in a more friendly direction (for example, the EU’s latest proposal to simplify rules), this variable could help ETH perform better than BTC.

Trading idea
💡 If the 10-year Treasury yield truly breaks above 6% and the move is mainly driven by expectations of Fed tightening, then BTC will face clear pressure in the $83,000–$82,500 range, and you may need to reduce exposure to manage risk. If the move is driven by fiscal concerns, there’s still room for a rebound above $85,000. Invalidation condition: If after the Treasury yield breaks 6%, the gold price drops sharply at the same time, it suggests risk appetite has worsened persistently—then this thesis is invalid.

2. **风险溢价主导型利空**：如果利率上涨是因为市场担心财政赤字、通胀或长期债券风险溢价（term premium）飙升，那么比特币反而可能受益，因为它被视为对冲这些宏观风险的工具。
Thielen的判断核心在于：前种情况是"系统性风险溢出"，后种情况是"风险偏好转移"。目前市场混合了两种因素，但后者占比可能正在增加。

对市场的影响
这意味着投资者不能简单地说"利率上升=比特币下跌"。具体传导路径要看资金流向：

- **对ETH**：以太坊受益弹性比BTC小，因为它仍有质押收益支撑。但只要驱动是美联储加息，所有风险资产都会承压。如果监管环境继续转向友好（比如欧盟最新提案的简化），这个变量可能让ETH表现优于BTC。

操作思路

然而，风险因素同样需要警惕。机构资金流向出现分化，现货以太坊ETF在连续七天净流入后，出现五千九百六十万美元的净流出，这可能反映出部分机构投资者在高位选择获利了结。链上安全事件也造成负面影响，MetaMask质押功能的安全漏洞导致部分验证者退出，引发市场担忧。此外，一个休眠的ICO钱包转移了十三万三千二百九十八枚以太坊，而价格在二千七百三十美元上方遭遇拒绝，触发三千六百万美元的大单流出。

从更宏观的视角看，以太坊正在经历从单纯的价值存储向实用型资产的转变。代币化股票在二零二六年增长百分之三百九十，虽然仅占全球股票市场总市值的万分之零点二九，但这一增速显示出巨大的发展潜力。九月代币化股票占据去中心化交易所交易量的百分之十一，正在缩小与模因币百分之十七的差距，这标志着资金正在向真实世界资产轮动。

Farside’s U.S. spot Ethereum fund flow table has summarized September 30 as net outflows of $59.6 million: Fidelity FETH outflow of $26.6 million, Grayscale Ethereum Mini Trust outflow of $25.5 million, and Grayscale ETHE outflow of $7.5 million. Previously, when I only saw partial products, I couldn’t treat the reported figure of about $33 million as the full-day ending value. Now, with the complete table, it’s a clearer snapshot of end-of-quarter flows. September 29 summarized net outflows of $2.8 million, with two consecutive trading days in the negative. However, the scale and composition differ, so you can’t infer that the entire Q4 will require redemptions solely based on two days.

More importantly, look at the timestamps. Farside’s current October 1 row still shows a dash for each product; the automatically aggregated 0.0 is not “zero net inflow confirmed for the day,” nor does it mean new net outflows have already appeared. Next, wait until the subscription/redemption data is filled in, then see whether it’s dominated by a single product. If it’s only end-of-quarter rebalancing, the pressure from consecutive net outflows could fade quickly. But if multiple funds continue to show net redemptions, for ETH to break above the prior high, it will need stronger spot demand to absorb those flows. This is a mechanism-based judgment of capital channel behavior—not saying that a fund’s daily U.S. dollar net outflow turns one-for-one into exchange sell pressure.

The market has already provided the other half of the information: when I checked Binance ETHUSDT, it was around $2,699.6. The rolling 24-hour high is $2,722 and the low is $2,667.94, up about 0.62% versus the 24-hour open. This suggests the price has not fallen one-directionally due to the already published end-of-quarter outflows; short-term buy pressure is still present. But the rebound near the 2700 whole-number level also doesn’t prove that institutional capital has flipped positive. $2,722 is the current upward validation level, and $2,668 is the lower volatility boundary. If the hourly close holds steadily above $2,722 while new fund data no longer shows widespread redemptions, then my view that the rebound can continue would strengthen. If it breaks below $2,668, or if newly reported net outflows continue to expand, I will overturn this mild, slightly bullish observation.

If this were my own trading, I wouldn’t participate. The direction would only consider unleveraged spot long positions. 9月30日ETH基金净流出已汇总｜10月1日尚未齐数｜ETH在2700附近我不追反弹

我的态度是谨慎偏多地观察，但现在不把价格回升当作机构资金重新流入的证据。Farside的美国现货以太坊基金表已把9月30日汇总为净流出5960万美元：富达FETH流出2660万，灰度Ethereum Mini Trust流出2550万，灰度ETHE流出750万。此前只看到部分产品时，不能把约3300万的已报数字当成全日终值；现在的完整表是一个更清楚的季末资金切面。9月29日汇总为流出280万，连续两个交易日为负，但规模和构成不同，不能仅凭两天推断整个第四季度都要赎回。

更重要的是时间戳。Farside当前10月1日一行各产品仍以短横线显示，自动汇总的0.0不是“当天确认零流入”，也不是已经出现新的净流出。接下来应等申购赎回数据补齐，再看是否由单一产品主导。如果只是季末再平衡，连续净流出的压力可能很快消退；如果多只基金继续出现净赎回，ETH要突破前高就需要更强的现货需求来承接。这是资金渠道的机制判断，不是说基金每天的美元净流出会一比一变成交易所抛盘。

市场已经给出另一半信息：我核对币安ETHUSDT时约2699.6美元，滚动24小时高2722、低2667.94，较24小时开盘约涨0.62%。这说明价格并未因已公布的季末流出单边下跌，短线买盘仍在；但2700整数位附近的反弹，也未证明机构资金已经转正。2722是眼前上方验证位，2668是下方波动边界。若小时收盘稳定在2722上方，同时新基金数据不再显示广泛赎回，我对反弹可延续的判断才增强；若跌破2668，或者新公布的净流出继续扩大，我会推翻眼下的温和偏多观察。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑无杠杆现货做多，计划仓位最多为总资金的2%，绝不预先埋单算作成交。入场触发是小时K线收在2722上方，随后回踩2705至2722不破，且10月1日基金数据出现后没有明显扩大净流出；条件缺一项就继续空仓。触发后第一目标2760，到了减一半，第二目标2810全部平仓；硬止损设在2688，或者入场后连续两根小时K线跌回2705下方主动平仓。若先破2668，整套计划取消，重新等结构，而不是补仓摊低成本。价格触发、基金确认和止损执行要分开核对，避免拿旧数据替今天的买盘背书。

📰 Why did Phantom suddenly add this feature to the BNB Chain? Users aren't that much more convenient, so what's the point?

Phantom Wallet announced that you can trade tokens on the BNB Chain without leaving the app. Previously, you had to jump to another wallet to handle transactions, which was pretty inconvenient. Now, it only takes a few taps in Phantom. This could help BNB Chain gain momentum, but it’s also a reminder that when you trade using this method, you need to assess the risks yourself. The news was first reported by Crypto Briefing.

Why is this news important?
Phantom is one of the most widely used wallets in the crypto world, and its new feature is like adding a direct line to the subway system of BNB Chain. Why does it matter? Simply put, it makes things more convenient for users, which may attract more people to play on BNB Chain. But BNB Chain itself hasn’t been very hot lately—on-chain activity is low. Whether this new feature can change the status quo is still up in the air. This means Phantom is helping, but whether it succeeds still depends on whether BNB Chain has the staying power.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, this news likely won’t have much impact. Phantom supports BNB Chain—it’s more like extending BNB Chain’s runway, with no direct connection to Bitcoin or Ethereum. But if BNB Chain really takes off because of Phantom, it could provide some uplift for smaller coins across the broader crypto market. For example, ETH’s market cap might indirectly benefit if overall on-chain activity increases across the ecosystem. On the other hand, if BNB Chain remains stagnant, this feature could be like building a beautiful park that nobody uses.

Trading outlook
💡 Personal view: slightly bearish/neutral. But as long as $773 holds, we’ll see whether BSC can rebound a little due to Phantom’s support. If BNB Chain’s daily active users stay below 50,000 over the next week, then this view is invalid.

📰 ETF dumps $149M, but Bitcoin hashrate rises for the first time—why are miners retreating en masse?

On Wednesday, Bitcoin ETFs that had seen inflows for nine straight days suddenly stopped. There was a net outflow of $148.69 million. This selling wave started with Fidelity and spread to most major crypto funds. Other crypto ETFs represented by Ethereum, Solana, and Cash App also fell, while the newly launched NEAR ETF rose against the trend. When ETF capital suddenly leaves, it is definitely not a good sign for market sentiment and the price of Bitcoin.

Why is this news important?
The root cause is a depletion of ETF liquidity. Nine consecutive days of inflows showed that the market’s confidence in regulated Bitcoin assets was building. But Wednesday’s reversal revealed that confidence was unraveling quickly. The withdrawal initiated by Fidelity, the largest participant, suggests that institutional investors are reassessing the risk-reward ratio. More importantly, this outflow happened against the backdrop of Bitcoin’s hashrate experiencing its first decline. Miners and ETF investors cut positions in sync—indicating that capital may be making decisions using the same logic: Bitcoin’s short-term upward momentum is fading.

The impact on the market can be seen in three areas. First, ETF outflows will directly translate into sell pressure on Bitcoin. Second, if this trend continues, it will accelerate regulators’ concerns about a “liquidity-pumping effect” from crypto funds. Third, before the September Federal Reserve meeting, this synchronized retreat may signal that risk appetite is cooling systemically.

A similar historical case is the ETF outflows before the crypto market crash in March 2020. Back then, the backdrop was regulatory scrutiny, whereas this time it is driven by technical factors (declining hashrate) plus macro factors (global equities running high), so the nature differs.

Impact on the market
In the short term, $84,440 is a key support level. If ETF outflows persist, Bitcoin could fall below this level. The impact on ETH may be lagged, but weakening Ethereum ETFs in sync suggests that smaller capital is exiting all major crypto assets. The long-term impact depends on how regulators respond—if ETFs are treated as a “safe haven,” then outflows could prompt tighter regulation, which might actually end up providing support.

The most dangerous signal is a resonance between falling hashrate and ETF outflows. This means miners and institutional investors are de-risking using the same logic. Such unified action often precedes a market turning point.

Trading/positioning thoughts
💡 I believe Bitcoin will most likely test the $80,000 support level in the near term. The combined pressure of ETF outflows and hashrate decline is likely to continue for at least two weeks. If ETFs continue to post net outflows of more than $100M next week, this view is invalid. If it breaks below 80K, this logic no longer holds.

📰 ETF狂卖149M，比特币算力却首次上涨，矿工为什么集体撤退？

周三比特币ETF连续九天流入突然中断，出现$148.69百万的净流出，这波卖出潮从Fidelity基金开始，蔓延到大多数主流加密基金。以以太坊、Solana、Cash App等为代表的其他加密ETF也收跌，唯有新上线的NEAR ETF逆势上涨。ETF资金突然离开，对市场情绪和比特币价格来说绝不是好信号。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事的根本原因在于ETF资金的流动性枯竭。连续九天流入说明市场对合规比特币资产的信心正在积累，但周三的逆转暴露了信心正在快速瓦解。Fidelity作为最大参与者发起的撤离，暗示机构投资者正在重新评估风险收益比。更关键的是，这种流出发生在比特币算力首次出现下滑的背景下，矿工和ETF投资者出现同步减仓现象——这表明资金可能在用同一种逻辑做判断：比特币短期上涨动能正在衰竭。

对市场格局的影响体现在三个层面：第一，ETF资金流出会直接转化为比特币的抛压；第二，如果这种趋势持续，将加速监管机构对加密基金"抽水效应"的担忧；第三，在9月美联储会议前，这种同步撤离可能预示着风险偏好正在系统性降温。

历史类似事件可以参考2020年3月加密市场崩盘前的ETF资金流出，但当时背景是监管审查，而这次是技术性原因（算力下降）+宏观因素（全球股市高企）叠加，性质有所不同。

对市场的影响
短期来看，$84,440这个位置是关键支撑位。如果ETF资金流出能持续，比特币可能跌破这个价位。对ETH的影响相对滞后，但以太坊ETF同步走弱暗示小资金正在从所有主流加密资产撤离。长期影响取决于监管机构的应对措施——如果将ETF视为"避风港"，资金流出可能引发监管加强，反而形成支撑。

最危险的信号是算力下降和ETF流出形成共振。这意味着矿工和机构投资者用同一种逻辑在减仓，这种统一行动往往预示着市场转折点即将到来。

操作思路
💡 我认为比特币短期大概率要测试$80,000支撑位，ETF流出+算力下滑的双重压力会持续至少两周。如果ETF在下周继续净流出超过$100M，这个判断作废。跌破80K这条逻辑就不成立。

二、以太坊ETH市场深度分析：承压整理，等待方向突破

二〇二六年十月一日，以太坊现货价格报二千六百八十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌零点四八个百分点。价格在二千六百七十三美元至二千七百零五美元区间内波动，整体呈现弱势整理格局。与比特币的相对强势不同，以太坊短线面临更多技术性压力，市场情绪偏谨慎。

一、价格走势分析

以太坊当前价格位于布林带中轨附近，上轨阻力位在二千七百一十五美元，中轨为二千六百九十四美元，下轨支撑位在二千六百七十二美元。价格在二千六百八十至二千六百九十二美元之间窄幅波动，布林带开口收窄，暗示变盘窗口正在临近。

均线系统方面，七小时均线二千六百九十二美元与二十五小时均线二千六百九十一美元几乎重合，且两者均位于九十九小时均线二千六百八十五美元上方。均线粘合是典型的变盘前兆，一旦价格选择方向突破，可能带来较大幅度的单边行情。指数移动平均线同样呈现粘合状态，七周期EMA为二千六百九十美元，二十五周期EMA为二千六百九十一美元，短线方向不明。

抛物线SAR指标位于二千七百一十四美元，高于当前价格，形成短线压力。超级趋势指标稳定在二千六百七十四美元，为价格提供底部支撑。价格运行在超级趋势线上方，中期趋势尚未转空。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标呈现明显的空头信号。MACD线为零点零一九，已跌破信号线一点五三六，柱状图为负一点五一七。回顾近期走势，MACD柱状图从零點一零七快速转负至负一点九四七，最新虽略有回升至负一点五一七，但整体空头动能仍占主导。MACD线从正值区域快速下滑至接近零轴，若继续下穿零轴将确认短线空头趋势。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI回升至五十点八二，十二周期RSI为五十点一九，二十四周期RSI为五十点四四。三个周期的RSI均集中在五十附近的中性区域，显示市场方向感缺失。此前六周期RSI一度下探至三十五点九五的超卖区域，当前反弹至中性区间，短线存在进一步反弹的可能。

KDJ指标中，K值为三十六点六一，D值为三十九点二六，J值为三十一点三一。K线低于D线，整体偏空运行。随机RSI仅为十二点八一，处于极度超卖区域，从技术角度看存在反弹修复的需求。

📰 Why Bitcoin’s Win Rate vs. the S&P 500 Bouncing Back Is a “Mirage”?

Bitcoin’s win rate versus the S&P 500 has recently climbed back above 50%. On the surface, it suggests investors’ confidence in crypto is strengthening—and could even lead some to view Bitcoin as an independent asset class. But this figure may be superficial, because the S&P 500’s recent performance has been so poor. It’s like an easy exam that helps more people pass.

Why is this news important?
The fundamental reason behind this rebound isn’t an increase in Bitcoin’s value—it’s the U.S. stock market’s overall decline (especially in tech stocks) dragging down the comparison ratio. It’s like an easy test: more high scores don’t necessarily mean students are actually getting better. Among the S&P 500’s major constituents, the stock drops for giants such as Apple, Amazon, and Meta have all exceeded 20%. That directly dilutes the significance of Bitcoin’s “victory.” More importantly, Bitcoin’s status as an “independent asset” has never truly been recognized by mainstream institutions. Beating a pool of dead water in U.S. equities alone is unlikely to change that situation.

Impact on the market
It can boost short-term sentiment for BTC/ETH, but the medium-term trend remains unclear. If Bitcoin can stay ahead even when the U.S. market rebounds, that would be stronger evidence of its independence. For now, this win-rate metric looks more like a “trash-bin effect”—just because others fall harder than I do doesn’t mean I’m actually that strong. In terms of the regulatory and macro backdrop, the Federal Reserve’s rate-hike expectations and global recession risks remain top negatives. These factors’ suppressive impact on Bitcoin far outweigh what this win-rate data suggests. Historical parallels: in 2017, when Bitcoin beat the stock market, it happened during a global quantitative easing cycle—when the background was completely different.

Trading approach
⚠️ If the Fed continues to hike rates by 75 basis points in September or delivers a surprise move beyond expectations, then the assessment of the comparison advantage is invalid. Simply put: if the U.S. market keeps crashing, then Bitcoin rising is normal; but if the market stabilizes and rebounds, and Bitcoin can’t keep outperforming, it means its underlying strength isn’t sufficient. Right now, Bitcoin’s price at $84,164 needs to hold; otherwise, the win-rate advantage will disappear again.

📰 为什么比特币战胜标普500胜率回升是场“假象”？

比特币对标普500的胜率最近重新超过50%，表面上显示投资者对加密货币信心增强，甚至可能让比特币被视为独立资产类别。但这个数据可能被表面化，因为标普500近期表现太差，就像考试简单导致更多人及格一样。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这个回升背后的根本原因不是比特币价值提升，而是美股大盘（尤其是科技股）连续暴跌拖累了对比率的影响。就像一场考试简单，高分变多并不代表考生水平真的提高了。目前S&P 500主要成分股中，苹果、亚马逊、Meta等巨头的股价跌幅都超过20%，这直接稀释了比特币胜利的含金量。更重要的是，比特币的"独立资产"地位从未被主流机构真正认可，仅靠战胜一潭死水的美股，很难改变这个格局。

对市场的影响

Copycat Season Index climbs above 60 and tops the hot list｜The threshold isn’t at 75 yet, and the ETH/BTC pair is weakening｜Around 2680, I won’t rush in

My stance is to observe rotation, not treat “Copycat Season is here” as a reason to immediately buy ETH. On Binance Square, #AltcoinSeasonIndexHoldsAbove60For5Days has appeared, saying the index has stayed above 60 for five straight days. First, let’s clarify the metric: CoinMarketCap’s methodology page uses the top 100 by market cap eligible coins, excludes stablecoins and wrapped assets, and compares performance over the past 90 days. Only when 75% of the coins outperform BTC is it defined as Copycat Season.

Here, 60 refers to the breadth of relative performance—not an average 60% rise of copycat coins, and not 60% of new capital flowing into the whole market. What I can verify is the index’s published methodology and the claims on the hot list. I have not treated the “five days持续” as an independently audited fact, and I also won’t mix similarly named indices from different platforms into one single standard.

Why single out ETH? Because among the high-weight, high-attention alt assets in the top market-cap tiers, ETH has both weight and focus. If funds truly rotate systematically from the BTC system, ETH/BTC often reveals relative strength better than looking at ETH’s USD price in isolation. But before this post, Binance’s ETH/BTC is about 0.03182, down around 0.19% over the last 24 hours, and it hasn’t shown clear relative outperformance. ETH/USDT is about $2680.06, with a 24-hour high of 2722 and a low of 2667.94, down around 0.26%. This doesn’t prove that “all alts are weak,” but it’s enough to remind me that a rising breadth indicator and incremental buy demand for ETH at this moment can coexist—or diverge. The index is a 90-day rolling “rearview mirror,” while the spot price is the trade happening right now; you can’t swap the time dimension.

My price observation levels are: around $2668, the 24-hour low; around $2687, the opening reference; and $2722, the upper edge of the range. If ETH/BTC keeps falling below 0.03182 and ETH’s USD price loses 2668, I would overturn the short-term stabilization expectation—even if the hot list still tags it as Copycat Season. Conversely, if ETH reclaims 2722, pulls back without breaking it, and ETH/BTC returns above 0.0320, then it would be more like relative strength and USD price confirming each other. One index above 60 is not enough to replace these two confirmations; even if the index rises to 75, it doesn’t guarantee ETH will necessarily go up on a given future day.

If it were my own trade: I wouldn’t participate. The bias is neutral, and my position is zero. Only if a one-hour close is above $2722; then the pullback still holds; and ETH/BTC doesn’t make new lows—then I’d use up to 4% of total funds to test a spot long, without leverage. First target: $2750; if near there, cut the position in half; then watch for $2780. After entry, if in one hour price drops back below 2687, I stop out. If ETH surges and then ETH/BTC breaks back below 0.03182, I close the remaining position entirely. If it breaks down first below 2668, the long setup is canceled. Rotation trading must consider whether relative returns truly turn—no hot phrase can replace discipline.

为什么ETH值得单独看？它在这类市值前列的山寨资产中权重和关注度都高，若资金真的从BTC系统性轮动，ETH/BTC往往比单看ETH美元价格更能揭示相对强弱。但发稿前币安ETH/BTC约0.03182，近24小时约跌0.19%，并没有给出清晰的相对走强；ETH/USDT约2680.06美元，24小时高2722、低2667.94，约跌0.26%。这不是“所有山寨都弱”的证明，却足以提醒我：广度指标走高与ETH这一刻获增量买盘可以并存，也可以背离。指数是90天滚动的后视镜，现货价是正在发生的交易，时间维度不能偷换。

我的价格观察位是2668美元附近的近24小时低点、2687美元附近的开盘参照、2722美元的区间上沿。若ETH/BTC继续跌破0.03182且ETH美元价失守2668，我会推翻短线企稳预期，哪怕热榜还挂着山寨季标签。相反，ETH若重新站上2722，回踩不破，同时ETH/BTC回到0.0320上方，才更像相对强度与美元价格共同确认。单独一个指数过60，不足以替代这两道确认；指数即便升至75，也不保证ETH未来单日必涨。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向中性，仓位为零。只有一小时收盘站上2722美元，随后回踩仍守住，并且ETH/BTC不再创新低，我才用总资金最多4%试现货多单，不加杠杆；先看2750美元，接近时减半，剩余再看2780。入场后若一小时跌回2687下方就止损；若上冲后ETH/BTC又跌穿0.03182，剩余仓位全部平掉。若先跌破2668，多头预案取消。轮动交易要看相对收益是否真的转向，不能靠一个热词替代纪律。

ETH itself is sitting around $2,697, right near its Monthly MA 50, inside the same consolidation range it's held since 2021. Still boxed in, still waiting.

It won't flip overnight. But the setup from the last two cycles is sitting right there, waiting on one number to confirm it.

ETH market depth analysis: the $2,700 battle zone—institutional positioning versus near-term pressure

1. Review of price action

As of the evening of October 1 (Beijing time), Ethereum is quoted at $2,696. Over the past 24 hours, the price has fluctuated slightly overall, trading in a narrow range between $2,674 and $2,711. From the hourly candlestick charts, the past five trading sessions have shown a choppy downward trend. The price has gradually pulled back from a high of $2,706 to $2,676, and the $2,670 area is becoming an important near-term support.

Notably, Ethereum’s cumulative gain over the past three months is close to 68%, significantly outperforming Bitcoin. Citibank raised its 12-month target price for Ethereum from $2,240 to $3,028, reflecting the institutions’ long-term optimism about Ethereum’s ecosystem development. However, in the short term, after price touched above the $2,700 level, it has faced clear profit-taking pressure.

2. Interpretation of technical indicators

Moving averages: the 7-hour MA is $2,694; the 25-hour MA is $2,691; and the 99-hour MA is $2,685. The three MAs are highly convergent, with an extremely small gap, suggesting the market is at a critical moment of direction selection. The exponential moving average trend is also converging: the 7-day EMA at $2,690 is nearly aligned with the simple moving average.

Bollinger Bands: the upper band is at $2,716, the middle band is at $2,693, and the lower band is at $2,670. The price is trading near the middle band, while the band width has continued to narrow to a recent low. Such an extreme Bollinger Band contraction often precedes a period of large volatility.

MACD: the DIF line is 0.58, the DEA line is 2.30, and the histogram is -1.72. The MACD histogram has been negative for two consecutive periods, and the negative value has expanded from -0.47 to -1.72, indicating that bearish momentum is accelerating. The DIF line has fallen below the DEA line to form a “dead cross,” implying a bearish short-term technical outlook.

RSI: the Relative Strength Index has dropped sharply. Over six periods, RSI fell rapidly from above 60 to 33.80, entering a relatively low zone. Over twelve periods, RSI is 42.55; over twenty-four periods, RSI is 46.80. RSI across timeframes is arranged bearishly, and short-term early oversold signals are emerging.

KDJ: the K line has dropped to 32.32, the D line to 44.03, and the J line to 8.89. The J line is now at an extremely low level, suggesting a potential need for a short-term technical rebound. The Williams %R indicator has fallen to -93.60, placing it in a severe oversold region.

ATR: the true range (ATR) has risen to 18.70, indicating a mild increase in volatility. The Super Trend line remains at $2,673; the price is still trading above the Super Trend line, meaning the intermediate bullish structure has not yet been broken.

3. Market sentiment analysis

Based on factor statistics, out of 15 factors, nine issue long signals, five issue short signals, and one remains neutral. The long-signal proportion reaches 60%. However, composite indicators provide a bearish signal overall, with a total win rate of about 68.75%. This suggests that although most factors look bullish, the historical accuracy of short signals is higher—so investors should stay alert.

Fundamentals: Ethereum’s ecosystem has seen important progress. The OUSD stablecoin issued by Bridge, a subsidiary of Stripe, has officially gone live. Its reserve assets are jointly held by BlackRock, Bank of New York Mellon, and Lead Bank, supporting 1:1 free minting and redemption on Base, Ethereum, Solana, and Tempo networks. Coinbase, Visa, and Mastercard have joined as founding partners. Stripe has set OUSD as the default stablecoin, and Aave has also proposed integrating it into the core markets of V3 and V4. This series of moves significantly increases the practical value of the Ethereum network and improves expectations for capital inflows.

On-chain data: during the price consolidation phase, large-wallet holdings have increased by roughly 60,000 ETH, providing strong bottom support. However, risk factors still cannot be ignored. For security and risk-prevention reasons, the Lido staking protocol has exited about 17,000 validator nodes, which could cause operational disruptions within a 45-day cycle. In addition, Ethereum spot ETFs recorded net outflows of approximately $59.60 million on September 30, and the short-term withdrawal of institutional funds is worth watching. Also, an old wallet from the ICO era transferred about 133,000 ETH, valued at roughly $358 million, increasing expectations of potential sell pressure.

Overall: Ethereum is currently at a crucial crossroads. In the medium to long term, the rollout of an institutional-grade stablecoin ecosystem, Citibank’s target price increase, and continued accumulation by large holders all provide a solid upward foundation. But in the short term, technical indicators are broadly weakening: a MACD dead cross, rapid RSI decline, and the Williams indicator in severe oversold territory. Combined with ETF outflows and potential sell pressure from old wallets, a breakout above $2,700 will likely require patience. It is recommended to watch the breakout direction after Bollinger Bands tighten. If the price can hold effectively above the upper band at $2,716, it may open new upside space. Conversely, if it breaks below the lower band support at $2,670, investors should watch for the risk of further pullbacks.

ETH市场深度分析：两千七百美元攻防战，机构布局与短期压力的博弈

一、价格走势回顾

截至北京时间十月一日晚间，以太坊报价两千六百九十六美元，过去二十四小时内价格微幅波动，整体在两千六百七十四美元至两千七百一十一美元之间窄幅整理。从小时级别K线来看，最近五个交易时段呈现震荡下行的态势。价格从两千七百零六美元的高位逐步回落至两千六百七十六美元，下方两千六百七十美元一线成为短期重要支撑。

值得注意的是，以太坊在过去三个月累计涨幅接近百分之六十八，表现显著优于比特币。花旗银行将以太坊十二个月目标价从两千两百四十美元上调至三千零二十八美元，反映出机构对以太坊生态发展的长期看好。然而短期来看，价格在触及两千七百美元上方后遭遇了明显的获利回吐压力。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报两千六百九十四美元，二十五小时均线报两千六百九十一美元，九十九小时均线报两千六百八十五美元。三条均线高度粘合，间距极小，表明市场正处于方向选择的关键时刻。指数移动均线同样呈现收敛态势，七日EMA为两千六百九十美元，与简单均线几乎重合。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于两千七百一十六美元，中轨为两千六百九十三美元，下轨为两千六百七十美元。价格在中轨附近运行，带宽持续收窄至近期低位，这种极端的布林带收缩往往预示着大幅波动即将到来。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为零点五八，DEA线为二点三零，柱状图为负一点七二。MACD柱状图已经连续两个周期为负值，且从负零点四七扩大至负一点七二，显示空头动能正在加速释放。DIF线已跌破DEA线形成死叉，短期技术面偏空。

RSI相对强弱指标出现了显著回落，六周期RSI从六十以上快速下降至三十三点八零，已经进入相对低位区域。十二周期RSI为四十二点五五，二十四周期RSI为四十六点八零，各周期RSI呈现空头排列，短期超卖信号初现。

KDJ指标中K线降至三十二点三二，D线降至四十四点零三，J线降至八点八九。J线已跌至极低位置，暗示短期可能存在技术性反弹需求。威廉指标跌至负九十三点六零，已进入严重超卖区域。

ATR真实波动幅度升至十八点七零，波动率温和放大。超级趋势线维持在两千六百七十三美元，价格仍在超级趋势线上方运行，中期多头结构尚未破坏。

三、市场情绪分析

从因子统计来看，十五个因子中有九个发出做多信号，五个发出做空信号，一个保持中性，做多比例达到百分之六十。然而复合指标却给出偏空信号，整体胜率约为百分之六十八点七五，说明虽然多数因子看涨，但做空信号的历史准确性更高，需要警惕。

基本面方面，以太坊生态迎来了重要进展。由Stripe旗下Bridge发行的OUSD稳定币正式上线，储备资产由贝莱德、纽约梅隆银行和Lead Bank共同持有，支持在Base、以太坊、Solana和Tempo网络上进行一比一自由铸造和赎回。Coinbase、Visa和万事达卡作为创始合作伙伴加入，Stripe将OUSD设为默认稳定币，Aave也提议将其整合至V3和V4核心市场。这一系列举措大幅提升了以太坊网络的实用价值和资金流入预期。

链上数据方面，大户钱包在价格盘整期间累计增持约六万枚以太坊，为价格提供了有力的底部支撑。然而风险因素同样不容忽视。Lido质押协议出于安全预防性考虑退出了约一万七千个验证节点，可能在四十五天的周期内造成运营层面的扰动。此外，以太坊现货ETF在九月三十日出现了约五千九百六十万美元的净流出，机构资金的短期撤退值得关注。一个ICO时代的旧钱包转移了约十三万三千枚以太坊，价值约三点五八亿美元，增加了潜在的抛压预期。

综合来看，以太坊当前正处于一个关键的十字路口。中长期来看，机构级稳定币生态的落地、花旗银行的目标价上调以及大户持续增持，都为价格提供了坚实的向上基础。但短期内技术指标全面走弱，MACD死叉、RSI快速下行、威廉指标严重超卖，叠加ETF资金流出和旧钱包抛压，两千七百美元的突破需要耐心等待。建议关注布林带收窄后的突破方向，若价格能有效站稳两千七百一十六美元上轨，则可能打开新的上行空间。反之，若跌破两千六百七十美元下轨支撑，则需防范进一步回调风险。

热门代币速览

MOVR，现价二点七六八美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之五十六点八三，完成Base网络一对一代币迁移后暴涨。

ALICE，现价零点二一四美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之三十点六五，元宇宙板块轮动上涨。

SYN，现价零点一九五八美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之十六点七八，跨链赛道持续受到关注。

ETH Q3 gain is about 70.9% and tops the hot list｜A new quarter doesn’t equal automatic continued gains｜Around $2,685 I’ll wait for incremental buy-side orders

My attitude is to respect the existing gains, but not to use a quarterly report as today’s buy order. Binance Square’s current trending topics show #EtherGains70.9%InQ3. I independently compute using publicly available Binance ETH/USDT monthly chart data: the July open is about $1,572, and the September close is about $2,686.01. Calculated using the same trading pair and the same quarter start/end, the gain is about 70.9%. This verifies the magnitude of the hot headline, but it’s only historical spot returns on Binance denominated in USDT; if you switch to other exchanges, a USD-based benchmark, or different start/end timestamps, the numbers may differ slightly—and you definitely can’t write it as realized gains already achieved in Q4.

Why is this topic worth watching? Quarterly gains affect the cost distribution of existing holders and the decisions they make for rebalancing: funds sitting on thicker unrealized profits may lock in gains in the new quarter, while trend-following funds may also keep adding. Both forces can exist at the same time. The historical quarterly gain itself is not new capital inflow. I’ve discussed the last round of ETH fund subscriptions/redemptions, the Glamdsterdam testnet preparation, and US employment data before; this time I’ll only focus on the difference between the “hot list return rate” and current tradable conditions, not treating the testnet schedule as a mainnet upgrade that’s already live, and not turning a single hot-list headline into ETF net subscriptions.

The immediate market reaction is nowhere near as exaggerated as the headline. When sampling Binance ETH/USDT around $2,685, the last 24-hour high is $2,722 and the low is $2,667.94—about a 0.17% move. In other words, the big quarterly rally has already been written into the prices from the past three months, while today we’re still roughly tugging around the $2,700 area. What I want to observe is whether $2,722 can become a new support, not chasing the 70.9% “rear-view mirror” number. If it falls below $2,668 and can’t rebound, the intraday range weakens and the view of “upward momentum following the new quarter” should be withdrawn. Only if it holds above $2,722 and the spot liquidity and fund net flows subsequently cooperate do we have stronger evidence of continuation.

If it were my own trade, I wouldn’t participate right now; I’d keep an empty position. If the hourly close breaks above $2,722, and the pullback still holds and is not a single-candle spike, then I’d use no more than 5% of total capital to probe a spot long. The entry trigger is the confirmed pullback; the first target is $2,780. Once reached, I’d cut half, and keep the remainder to watch around $2,820, but I wouldn’t assume it must get there. The stop-loss is placed at the point where the pullback structure fails; if the hourly close falls back below $2,700, I’ll execute the stop-loss and close the position rather than turning it into a long-term bag-holding situation. If price first loses $2,668, I won’t guess the bottom—I’ll wait for it to stand back up or for a new range to form. Each trade’s maximum preset risk is no more than 0.5%, and I don’t use high leverage. If the conditions aren’t met, there’s no trade and no profit worth reviewing.

Quarterly statistics are facts; the next step is to test the hypothesis with price action, and position size is only handed to the trigger conditions. #EtherGains70.9%InQ3 #ETH

The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

ETH三季度涨幅约70.9%登热榜｜新季度不等于自动续涨｜2685美元附近我先等增量买盘

我的态度是尊重既有涨幅，但不拿季度成绩单替今天的买单。币安广场当前热门话题显示#EtherGains70.9%InQ3。我用币安ETH/USDT月线公开数据独立核算：7月开盘约1572美元，9月收盘约2686.01美元，按同一交易对、同一季度起止计算，涨幅约70.9%。这能验证热门标题的数量级，但只是币安现货、USDT计价的历史回报；换成其他交易所、美元口径或不同起止时刻，数值可能略有差别，更不能把它写成四季度已实现收益。

为什么这个话题值得看？季度涨幅会影响持仓者的成本分布和再平衡决策：浮盈较厚的资金可能在新季度锁定收益，追随趋势的资金也可能继续加仓，两种力量同时存在。历史涨幅本身不是新增资金流。上一轮ETH基金申赎、Glamsterdam测试网准备和美国就业数据我都讨论过，这次只聚焦“热榜回报率”与当前可交易条件的差别，不把测试网日程说成主网升级已落地，也不把一条热榜写成ETF净申购。

市场已给出的即时反应没有热榜标题那么夸张。取样时币安ETH/USDT约2685美元，24小时最高2722、最低2667.94美元，涨幅约0.17%。也就是说，季度大涨已写进过去三个月的价格，而今天仍围绕2700美元上下拉锯。我要观察的是2722美元能否变成新的支撑，而不是追逐70.9%这个后视镜数字；若跌破2668美元并反抽不过，当前日内区间转弱，所谓“新季度顺势上涨”的判断要撤销。若站稳2722且现货量能、基金净流向随后配合，才有更强的延续证据。

如果是我自己交易，此刻不参与，方向保持空仓。若小时收线突破2722美元，回踩仍守住且不是单笔插针，我才用总资金不超过5%试探现货多单；入场触发是确认后的回踩，第一目标2780美元，达到后先减仓一半，余仓观察2820美元附近，但不预设一定到达。止损放在回踩结构失效处；若小时收线重新落回2700美元下方，就执行止损并平仓，不改成长期套牢。若价格先失守2668美元，我不猜底，等重新站回或重新形成区间。每笔账户最大预设风险不超过0.5%，不使用高杠杆。条件不满足就没有成交，也没有可复盘的盈利。

季度统计是事实，下一步走势是待验证假设，仓位只交给触发条件。#EtherGains70.9%InQ3 #ETH

📰 Why did the U.S. Treasury suddenly allow it? Why can states file Stablecoin certification early?

On September 30, the U.S. Department of the Treasury issued a new rule allowing states to submit Stablecoin certification materials before the official regulations are finalized. However, these materials will not undergo a substantive review, nor can they directly approve a state’s regulatory framework. This policy is good news for states looking to develop Stablecoin businesses in advance, as it lets them lay the groundwork early. But for companies hoping to get licensed quickly, they still have to wait for the official rules to be released.

Why is this news important?
The main reason the Treasury is moving ahead is that it has seen the Stablecoin industry grow too fast, while federal-level oversight has not caught up. Essentially, the policy that took effect on September 30 gives states a “preview pass” so they can familiarize themselves with regulatory requirements first. But the Treasury will not begin审理 in earnest until the approval process under the Paperwork Reduction Act is completed. This could push back the timeline for regulatory rollout, yet it provides businesses with a clearer framework for what to expect. This echoes the regulatory recommendations jointly proposed earlier this year by the Federal Reserve and the SEC—both aim to use tiered oversight, with states moving first and the federal government stepping in afterward.

Impact on the market
For BTC and ETH, the news is relatively neutral; in the short term it may spark some trading sentiment, but it won’t change the overall direction. What’s more worth watching is the signal it sends: regulators recognize that Stablecoins could be a potential stabilizer within the financial system, but they also fear losing control. This contradictory mindset could lead to policy swings. There are few historical precedents like this, but the legislative process for the EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) framework in 2019 had a similar phase—first setting transitional rules for member states, then gradually tightening them. In terms of capital flows, short term this may increase competitive pressure among state-level regulators, while in the long run it could lead to more divergence in the regulatory landscape. Stablecoins on public chains like BNB Chain and Solana may benefit from some states’ more permissive early pilot policies.

💡 I believe this means the regulatory cycle will be extended by 6–9 months, but ultimately it will form a model similar to the EU’s “federal framework + state implementation.” This assessment would be invalid if, within the next three months, there is a major hacking incident, or if a state proposes an extremely non-compliant regulatory plan.

#Ethereum rises 70.9% in Q3: the increase is concentrated in August, and the quarter’s end is still below the intra-period high

Binance Square’s trending chart summarizes Ethereum’s Q3 rise as 70.9%. I recalculated using Binance’s publicly available ETHUSDT spot daily data: taking the July 1 opening price of $1,572.00 as the start point and the September 30 closing price of $2,686.01 as the end point, the rise over the interval is about 70.9%. This is a price-return measure—it excludes staking gains, fees, and it isn’t equal to the actual returns of all holders.

This rally did not happen at a steady pace. Calculated by opening price of the first daily candle in each natural month to the closing price of the last daily candle, July is up about 18.5%, August up about 32.5%, and September up about 8.8%. In other words, August contributed the most; September is still up, but the pace has slowed. Breaking the quarter numbers apart shows where the action was concentrated better than looking only at the start and end.

The drawdown within the quarter is also worth keeping. As shown by the daily data, the September 21 high was $2,807.34, while the September 30 close was $2,686.01—about 4.3% lower than the high. So “Q3 up 70.9%” describes the performance over the interval; it does not mean that late September was still at the peak, and you also can’t infer Q4’s direction from that.

The recalculation method is to use the open and close fields from Binance spot ETHUSDT daily candlesticks. Quarterly return = (Sept 30 close / July 1 open − 1). Monthly returns are calculated using the first daily candle’s opening price and the last daily candle’s closing price for the corresponding month. Different exchanges, time-zone splits, or using intraday prices will produce slightly different numbers. Monthly percentage gains also can’t simply be added together: they’re computed from each month’s own start- and end-of-month prices, while the overall quarter is determined by the quarter’s start and end points. This price series can only answer “how much the price moved during this period,” and it cannot, by itself, explain whether the rally was driven by capital flows, supply and demand, or macro expectations. For attribution, you would need to look up capital-flow data, on-chain activity, and events during the same period. Any assessment of future performance should also be based on new price and trading data, not treat realized quarterly returns as a continuation signal. Information as of 2026-10-01 22:35 (Beijing time). Source: Binance publicly available spot candlestick data.

US weekly initial jobless claims come in at 197,000 as it hits the hot list｜Fewer layoffs doesn’t necessarily mean stronger hiring｜ETH around 2,697—I'll wait for the Non-Farm

My stance is that even after the data comes out, I won’t chase a direction. The accurate topic rising on Binance Square is #USWeeklyJoblessClaimsFallTo197000; this time it’s a firsthand report from the U.S. Department of Labor you can verify, so there’s no need to rely only on the hot list. The Department of Labor reported on October 1: for the week ending September 26, seasonally adjusted initial claims for unemployment insurance were 197,000, down by 1,000 from the previously revised 198,000; the four-week average was 200,000, down by 2,500 from the prior revised figure. Continuing claims for the week ending September 19 were 1.701 million, down by 110,000 from the previously revised 1.712 million. Note that initial and continuing claims are reported for different weeks, and the prior values were also revised—so you can’t simply add the two series together.

For the crypto market, what matters most is not the “down by 1,000” direction, but how the labor market affects rate expectations. Lower initial claims often mean firms aren’t cutting jobs at large scale, which may reduce the market’s bets on imminent easing; but initial claims reflect applications for unemployment insurance, not new hires, and they can’t prove that wage pressure is accelerating. ETH has no bond coupon; if the cost of capital stays high, it can suppress valuations for parts of risk assets. On the other hand, if employment resilience supports economic growth, it may improve risk appetite. This is two-way transmission—so you can’t write 197,000 as “ETH must fall” or “ETH must rise.” The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics plans to release the September employment report at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 2; Beijing time is 8:30 p.m. on October 2. That’s when you’ll get a more complete puzzle—non-farm payrolls, unemployment rate, and more. Nothing has been published yet.

The current price reaction isn’t very pronounced. When I was writing, Binance ETH/USDT was around 2,697.32, about -0.05% over the past 24 hours, with a range from 2,667.94 to 2,722.00, and close to the 24-hour open of 2,698.79. This kind of basically flat behavior isn’t enough to prove the market has already priced the claims data into a one-way move, nor can all intraday swings be attributed to macro news. I’m watching the top at 2,722 and the bottom at 2,668: if before the employment data is released neither side effectively breaks through, it looks more like waiting. If price first breaks below 2,668 and the retest can’t reclaim it, a cautious assessment would turn into a stronger defensive bias. If rate expectations cool and price holds above 2,722, then that would be evidence invalidating my earlier wait-and-see judgment.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t enter now—directional waiting, position size 0%. Only if there’s an hourly close above 2,722 and a pullback to 2,712–2,722 that holds, and BTC doesn’t simultaneously dump sharply, I would use up to 0.75% of total funds to take a spot long. First target 2,750 (taking half off), second target 2,780 (closing the remaining position). After entry, if there’s an hourly close back below 2,705, I’ll cut half; hard stop at 2,690 and close everything. If price first breaks 2,668 or if the spread around the time of the Non-Farm release becomes abnormally wide, I’ll cancel this plan and stay in cash with no position. No high leverage, and I won’t try to guess tomorrow night’s official Non-Farm outcome just from one weekly initial claims number.

Source: U.S. Department of Labor Oct 1 Unemployment Insurance Weekly Report; U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics employment report schedule; Binance ETH/USDT real-time quotes.#USWeeklyJoblessClaimsFallTo197000 #ETH

title: 3个问题看清DeFi真假，你的钱包自己管就够了吗？
subTitle:
你是不是也把“资产上链、能连钱包”直接当成DeFi？真正容易踩坑的地方是：非托管只是起点，不代表平台无法干预你的交易。

判断一个项目有多“去中心化”，不用先研究一堆术语，直接问三个问题。

1. 资产到底由谁控制？

如果币要先转进平台，由平台或第三方保管，你拿到的只是平台记账凭证，那它本质上仍属于CeFi。传统银行、中心化交易所都是这类结构。

只有资产由你通过私钥控制，才算迈进DeFi。但别急，这只是必要条件。

2. 有没有人能单独阻止交易？

看看管理员、公司或其他单一主体，能否冻结账户、限制提款，或者阻止兑换和借贷。

如果答案是“能”，说明它可能使用了链上结算，但交易入口仍有明显的中心化控制点。对你来说，这意味着“交易上链”不等于“谁都拦不住”。

3. 有没有人能暂停整个协议？

这是最容易被忽略的一层。核心团队或基金会能否单方面暂停合约、升级逻辑、修改关键参数？如果能，它可以是非托管的，也可以让交易在链上完成，但治理权依然高度集中。

按这三个问题，可以从CeFi、中介接入DeFi结算、中心化治理的DeFi，一直分到完全DeFi。原素材认为，真正达到最后一层的项目极少，$BTC 和 $ETH 可能更接近这一标准，因为目前很难由某个单一个体左右其共识机制。

所以，看盘和交易前别只盯价格与收益率，也要查清资产托管方式、冻结权限和合约暂停权。项目页面写着DeFi，不代表你面对的就是同一种风险。

下次研究项目时，先把这三个问题写在备忘录里，再决定是否参与。

Do you also take “putting assets on-chain and being able to connect a wallet” as DeFi? The place that’s easiest to trip over is: non-custody is just the starting point, and it doesn’t mean the platform can’t interfere with your transactions.

To judge how “decentralized” a project really is, don’t study a bunch of terms first—just ask three questions.

1. Who actually controls the assets?

If the coins must be transferred into the platform first, and the platform or a third party holds them, then what you receive is only the platform’s bookkeeping records—essentially, they still belong to CeFi. Traditional banks and centralized exchanges are structures like this.

Only when the assets are controlled by you through your private key does it count as entering DeFi. But hold on—this is just a necessary condition.
