Why do contract fees cost more for some people and less for others? Actually, it’s just one action

First, the conclusion: instant execution = taking orders, fee 0.05%; placing limit orders further away from the current price and slowly queuing for a fill only costs 0.02%. Going back and forth is over twice as much.

Many people think that choosing a limit order means just “placing” an order in the book—but not necessarily. For example, if the current price is 100,000, and you place a buy order at 100,0001 thousand, the system will immediately match and take the existing orders on the order book to execute the trade. It’s nominally a limit order, but in practice you’re charged the take-order fee of 0.05%.

To get the lower fee rate, there’s just one sentence: for buy orders, set the price lower than the current price; for sell orders, set it higher than the current price, and be patient while waiting in the queue. If you frequently enter and exit at market price, the yearly trading fees are enough to buy quite a few lots.

The healthcare technology company Evernorth, supported by Ripple investments, is set to list on Nasdaq. What’s special about this listing is that it will become the largest official reserve custody in XRP’s history, holding XRP worth about $316 million. After the news broke, XRP briefly rose, but then kept falling—showing that the market is taking a long time to digest this “dual identity” logic.

Why is this news important?
Evernorth’s Nasdaq listing is essentially a spotlight moment for XRP’s real-world application to finally take shape. It forcibly moves XRP from “cryptocurrency” to the position of a “mainstream financial partner,” aligning with Ripple’s years-long “compliance is the way to win” strategy. The $316 million reserve is the key number—equivalent to about 1.5% of XRP’s total circulating supply (based on the current market price), far exceeding the holdings of any previous institution or project backer. This means XRP’s compliance-related attributes are being certified in one fell swoop; in theory, it could unlock more institutional funding.

Market impact
It doesn’t meaningfully affect BTC and ETH. These two brothers have recently been stealing the spotlight with AI computing power, and they’ve shown a muted reaction to this indirect XRP positive catalyst. For XRP itself, it’s a line of demarcation between bullish and bearish sentiment: on one hand, this is Ripple’s strongest “institutional empowerment” narrative and should, in theory, support the coin’s price; on the other hand, XRP has been in a downtrend with three consecutive days of limit-down, with extremely bearish technicals—this kind of positive news just isn’t enough to reach and break the downward trend line.

A historical reference is 2019, when Bitfinex became one of the top ten XRP holders. But that time, the price surged 300% within six months. Today’s XRP market size and the current drawdown are completely different.

ETHB’s fee rate isn’t the same thing as staking net returns｜Two layers of fee denominators differ｜Around ETH at 2707 I’ll wait

My stance is: Ethereum staking funds can broaden how institutions participate, but you can’t just infer that ETH will immediately get new buy pressure based on the three words “low fee rate.” I checked the product page for BlackRock’s iShares ETHB: the fund’s standard sponsor fee is 0.25% of net assets; starting March 12, 2026, for the first 12 months, there’s a staged fee waiver on the first $2.5 billion of assets, with the relevant fee rate at 0.12%. Any portion beyond that asset size still applies 0.25%. This isn’t “0.12% on all assets forever,” and it’s certainly not a fund that guarantees an annualized return.

Another commonly confusing figure comes from the prospectus supplement: the fund sponsor, execution agent, and others collectively take 10% from the “total staking rewards,” and the fund keeps the remainder. Later pages of the PDF still show the original 18% from the base prospectus, but the supplement terms clearly replace the old paragraph—when reading, you should first look at the updated text that takes effect. 0.12% or 0.25% is the sponsor fee calculated on the fund’s net assets; 10% is a split on the actual staking rewards generated. These have different denominators, so you can’t just add them to get 10.12% or treat it as investors’ net return. Staking also comes with risks such as validator performance, custody, exit queue delays, and regulatory changes—and the reward amount isn’t guaranteed.

Why is this worth tracking for traders? If an ETF holds and stakes part of its ETH, it may change the cost and return structure for how traditional accounts gain exposure to Ethereum. But choosing one product is not the same as the spot exchange instantly seeing an equivalent net buy order. You have to look at subscription/redemption flows and custody position changes to understand fund flows. Price is also affected by BTC direction, USD liquidity, and on-chain activity. Farside currently shows that as of September 30, the aggregate ETH fund data was a net outflow of about $59.6 million; the ETHB column for that day displays zero. This is just existing daily reporting and may be revised—so you can’t claim that institutions completely exited today based on it, nor can you treat fee discounts as inflows.

At the time of writing, Binance’s ETH/USDT is around $2706.82, with a 24-hour high of $2738.51 and a low of $2667.94—slightly up versus 24 hours ago. It’s still within its range, and there hasn’t been a breakout that can be attributed solely to ETHB’s fee terms. I’m treating $2738 as the upper boundary and $2668 as the lower boundary; if the market is just lively because of news headlines but the price/volume can’t cooperate, the market will eventually overturn that conclusion.

If I were trading it myself: I would not participate right now—neutral on direction, with a position size of zero. Only if ETH closes above $2740 for one hour, then retests without losing support, and BTC does not break below its intraday support at that time, would I consider going long spot. The maximum position would be 2% of total capital. The first target is $2780; once hit, I’d cut the position by half. The second target is $2820; any remaining position would use a moving take-profit. If after entry price falls back below $2715, I’d stop out and close the trade—there’s no need to use “staking returns” as a reason to hold through. If price breaks below $2668 first, the entire long setup is invalid and I’ll wait for a new structure to form. My priority will always be confirmed capital flows and price action—not invent a short-term story from fund fee provisions.

Source: iShares ETHB product page and prospectus supplement; Farside ETH fund daily report; Binance ETH/USDT行情. #ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETHB优惠费率不是质押净收益｜两层费用分母不同｜ETH在2707附近我先等

我的态度是：以太坊质押基金能扩大机构参与方式，但不能只看“低费率”三个字就推断ETH马上有新买盘。查了贝莱德iShares的ETHB产品页，基金常规赞助费率为净资产的0.25%；从2026年3月12日起前12个月，对前25亿美元资产实行阶段性减免，相关部分费率为0.12%，超过该资产规模的部分仍适用0.25%。这不是所有资产、永久统一收0.12%，更不是基金保底年化收益。

另一个容易混淆的数字来自招募书补充文件：基金赞助方与执行代理等从“总质押奖励”中合计取得10%，基金保留剩余奖励。PDF后面仍能看到原基础招募书写的18%，但前面的补充条款明确替换旧段落，阅读时要先看生效的更新文本。0.12%或0.25%是按基金净资产计算的赞助费；10%是对实际产生的质押奖励进行分成，两个分母不同，不能简单相加成10.12%或当作投资者净回报。质押还存在验证者、托管、退出排队和监管变化风险，奖励金额也不保证。

为什么这值得交易员跟踪？ETF持有并质押一部分ETH，可能改变传统账户获得以太坊敞口的成本与收益结构；但投资者选择一只产品，和交易所现货立刻出现等额净买单不是同一回事。资金流要看申购赎回与托管持仓变化，价格还受BTC方向、美元流动性及链上活动影响。Farside目前9月30日ETH基金汇总为净流出约5960万美元，ETHB该日栏显示零；这只是既有日报且可能修订，不能据此宣称今天机构完全撤离，也不能把费率优惠算成流入。

撰稿时币安ETH/USDT约2706.82美元，24小时高2738.51、低2667.94，较24小时前小幅上涨。它仍在区间内，没有出现可以单独归因于ETHB费率条款的突破。我把2738附近当上沿，2668附近当下沿；若市场只是新闻标题热闹、量价却无法配合，判断会被现实推翻。

如果是我自己交易：当前不参与，方向中性，仓位零。只有ETH一小时收盘突破2740美元，并回踩不失守，同时BTC不跌破其当时日内支撑，我才考虑现货做多，仓位最多总资金的2%。第一目标看2780美元，触及后减半；第二目标看2820美元，剩余仓位用移动止盈。若入场后重新跌回2715美元下方就止损平仓，不用“质押收益”当扛单理由。若先跌破2668美元，整套多头计划作废，等待重新形成结构。我的优先级永远是验证资金与价格，而不是拿基金条款给短线行情编故事。

MetaMask exits Lido validator nodes after security incident! ETH staking safety once again in focus

After encountering an infrastructure security incident, MetaMask announced preventive measures:
- Exiting affected Ethereum validator nodes.

These validator nodes previously participated in ETH staking via the Lido protocol. Lido stated that the relevant validator nodes operated by MetaMask Staking have already begun the exit process, which is expected to be completed no later than October 7.

However, there’s one key point:
There is currently no evidence that MetaMask wallet users’ assets are directly at risk.
MetaMask said this incident affects part of the infrastructure, and in its non-custodial staking business, users’ withdrawal keys are not managed by MetaMask.

Why is this worth paying attention to?
① Validator node security becomes the focus
ETH staking depends on validators running. If there is a risk to node infrastructure, operators typically choose to proactively exit to reduce potential impact.

② Exiting brings opportunity costs
Lido reminded that during the exit period of the affected validators, some staking rewards may be lost, and penalties related to downtime may also occur.

③ Once again highlights the importance of decentralized infrastructure

In the past, the market focused more on:
- Wallet security
- Private key security
- Exchange security

But as the scale of ETH staking grows, the security capabilities of node operators are becoming increasingly important.
This incident is not about user assets being stolen; it’s a proactive defense against infrastructure risk.

Next, what the market will watch:
👉 Results of the MetaMask security incident investigation
👉 Exit progress of the affected validator nodes
👉 How the ETH staking ecosystem can further raise security standards

In one sentence:
Crypto security is not only about protecting assets in your wallet—it also includes the infrastructure that supports the entire network.

title: ♾️ Infinity Grid: Cómo capitalizar un Bull Run sin techo y sin vender tu inventario
subTitle:
En un mercado francamente alcista (Bull Run), la mayor desventaja del Spot Grid tradicional es que, al alcanzar el límite superior preestablecido, el bot vende todo el activo asignado a USDT y queda fuera del movimiento ascendente.
El Infinity Grid (Grilla Infinita) resuelve este problema eliminando por completo el límite superior. Su algoritmo asegura que el valor total en USDT de tu posición crezca proporcionalmente con el precio, vendiendo solo las fracciones necesarias para mantener constante el valor de la base del activo.
1. La Matemática detrás del Infinity Grid
A diferencia de las grillas fijas basadas en rangos de precios:
Mantenimiento del Valor Base: Si inicias una posición con $1,000$ USDT en $BTC$, el bot ajusta continuamente las órdenes para que el valor de tu tenencia principal no cambie en términos relativos, ejecutando Take Profits porcentuales diminutos en cada nuevo máximo.Sin Límite Superior: Mientras el mercado continúe subiendo, el bot seguirá tomando ganancias en USDT de forma continua e ilimitada.
2. Spot Grid Tradicional vs. Infinity Grid
Spot Grid Tradicional: Diseñado para rangos laterales definidos con soporte y resistencia consolidados. Se detiene al romper la resistencia clave.Infinity Grid: Ideal para activos en fase de descubrimiento de precios (Price Discovery) o en tendencias alcistas estructurales de largo plazo, donde fijar un techo limita la rentabilidad.
3. Consejo Táctico Express (Cómo configurar el Porcentaje por Grilla)
💡 El "Tip" Infinito: Al configurar tu Infinity Grid en Binance, establece el Beneficio por Grilla entre 0.5% y 1.2%. Dado que esta estrategia está pensada para sostenerse durante semanas o meses en tendencias alcistas, un porcentaje por grilla ligeramente más amplio permite capturar movimientos más limpios y maximizar el beneficio neto libre de comisiones de la plataforma.

【Citi Raises Its Target, but the Market Isn’t Chasing: First Look for a Breakout, Then Believe the Narrative】

On October 1, Citi raised its 12-month target to:

• $BTC: 82,000 → 113,000 USD
• $ETH: 2,240 → 3,028 USD

The rationale includes a rebound in crypto market activity, an improved macro environment, and renewed ETF fund inflows. In the coming 12 months, it estimates inflows of about $5 billion.

But the price reaction has been rather restrained. Binance data updated at 19:08 (Taipei time) shows BTC at about $83,866, up only 0.24% over the past 24 hours; ETH at about $2,698, up 0.47%.

On an implied basis, Citi’s nominal upside versus the current price is roughly 35% for BTC and 12% for ETH. However, an “analyst target price” is not an immediate buy signal. Especially since BTC and ETH have already rebounded nearly 40% and 68%, respectively, over the past three months; this raise may simply be institutional acknowledgment of an existing trend.

Next, watch for two sets of price confirmations:

🔸 BTC
If it can hold above the 24-hour high near $85,600 with volume, only then does the institutional narrative have a chance to translate into a new trend. If it breaks below the low near $83,100, it means the news failed to attract follow-through, and the move should still be treated as range-bound.

🔹 ETH
First, see whether it can reclaim and hold $2,737. Only if that succeeds is there a condition to retest the $3,000 psychological level. If it loses $2,667, short-term momentum will clearly cool off.

What truly matters isn’t how high an investment bank writes its numbers, but whether ETF inflows can remain sustained, whether price can break out, and whether the U.S. dollar and bond yields cooperate. A target price is a scenario—not a guarantee.

10 月 1 日，花旗把 12 個月目標上調至：

• $BTC：82,000 → 113,000 美元
• $ETH：2,240 → 3,028 美元

理由包括加密市場活動回升、宏觀環境轉佳，以及 ETF 資金重新流入；未來 12 個月預估流入約 50 億美元。

但價格反應相當克制。Binance 於台北時間 19:08 更新的數據顯示，BTC 約 83,866 美元、24 小時僅漲 0.24%；ETH 約 2,698 美元、上漲 0.47%。

先看能否收復並守住 2,737 美元；成功才有條件再測試 3,000 美元心理關口。若失守 2,667 美元，短線動能將明顯降溫。

title: ETH 2700 成了“绞肉机”，为什么大资金专盯急躁的散户？
subTitle:
眼下以太坊正卡在2700这个不上不下的中间价位。
大资金目前就在2626到2750这个宽敞的箱体里来回搓揉洗盘。 很多散户在这个位置急得跳脚，生怕错过主升浪或者大暴跌。
我目前的判断很简单：这里没有单边行情，中间价位全是绞肉机。 在这个不上不下的地方开枪，纯粹是给庄家送过路费。

前阵子，我找人约了个钢琴老师。
我是个理性选手，我知道任何一门学科，入门都需要三年，想稍微有点起色怎么也要五年打底。 我就想弄明白，如果按五年的长线规划，我该怎么分配时间？
女老师一开始挺警惕，估计在想我这个“油腻大叔”是不是想泡她，毕竟在她那个圈子，遇到的大多是玩票的。 她跟我交了底，说以前在苏州待过，有传媒公司老板高薪聘她，专门给女主播做培训。 
要求极其简单粗暴：一两个月内，必须教会女主播弹几首曲子。然后让这些姑娘穿得少一点，坐在镜头前直播。 女老师当时都凌乱了，觉得这些老板脑子有病。一两个月怎么可能学得会钢琴？真需要弹琴的，外面大把找不到工作的音乐生，直接招来当主播不就行了？
其实，是她没看懂这个商业生态。 老板要的根本不是什么音乐素养。这个生态的核心，是主播必须会聊天、会经营人气。至于那架钢琴，还有那几首速成的曲子，仅仅是个吸引流量的道具而已。 老板算的是一笔极短的现金流快账。他等不了三年五年，他就看这一个月能不能把大哥口袋里的钱掏出来。
大部分普通人，骨子里也是这么短视的。 哪怕做个学习计划，也不敢超过一年，动不动就问，几个月能要什么结果？ 他们去用那种识谱APP，屏幕上显示数字几，手指就跟着按几。这样来得最快，一周就能弹《欢乐颂》。 但我学琴，强迫自己关掉这些数字提示，从认七八个音符开始，像打游戏一样枯燥地练指法。
不仅是弹琴，任何需要建立“盘感”的技能都是如此。就像当年我学打字，用的是最老的智能ABC。 我能把每个字敲哪几个键、数字选几，全部变成潜意识，根本不需要思考。 后来出了各种高级的智能输入法，自动联想，打错了也能猜到你要什么字。业余玩家觉得这种快，但对我这种靠码字吃饭的人来说，智能输入法反而慢。因为它的词频不固定，位置老变，容易打错。
只有用最笨的办法把按键位置刻进肌肉记忆里，你脑子里的东西才能像说话一样自然流淌。 只要打字跟不上大脑的思考，人就会分神，就无法聚焦。这层窗户纸一戳就破，但没几个人愿意下那个笨功夫。
盘子里的资金，其实分得很清。 那些在2700这个中间价位，看着一根阳线就追多、一根阴线就割肉的散户，就像那些看着APP上的数字提示，急匆匆想弹完一首曲子的业余玩家。 他们总想要个极其确定的短期反馈。#ETH 

但你看看大资金在干嘛？ 人家在2626到2750这个大区间里，做着最枯燥、最机械的极限施压。 价格砸到2626附近，有真金白银在那里兜底，把带血的筹码吸走。一旦反抽到2750附近，前期的套牢盘和主力派发的筹码就一起往下盖。 这就叫肌肉记忆。人家只在最边缘的供需区做买卖，把风险降到最低。
大资金根本不跟你谈什么短期的音乐梦想，人家就是在两头收割流动性。 你跑到2700这个没依没靠的中间路段去押注，往上往下都有几十刀的空间。除了被来回搓揉，耗干本金，你拿不到任何优势。
不如把周期拉长一点，别急着今天就要分个胜负。 等价格真冲到了2750附近，多头的钱接不上了，涨不动了。 那些急躁的筹码开始害怕的时候。 咱们再去接手这笔生意。

Last month, Solana’s app revenue surged to $18 million, a nine-month high. But oddly, the coin price fell by 1.47% today. This suggests that the Solana ecosystem is indeed improving, yet its market share is shrinking—everyone in the broader Web3 community is getting more cutthroat.

Why is this news important?
Solana’s revenue spike indicates that its application ecosystem is growing healthily, with both developers and users flocking in. But the drop in the token price reveals a harsh reality: the Web3 pie is limited. The stronger Solana gets, the smaller the slice other chains (such as Aptos, Sui, Tezos) get. This is reminiscent of the 2021 crypto market—when a chain ecosystem explodes, but the token price first falls and then rises. The fundamental reason is that incremental capital can’t keep pace with the ecosystem’s expansion speed, and the fight for market share has entered a white-hot phase.

Impact on the market
In the short term, Solana’s new revenue high may boost confidence in the broader L2 solutions sector, but BTC and ETH are unlikely to surge as a result. That’s because Solana is a competitor to Ethereum— the more it earns, the more pressure Ethereum faces. In the long term, if L2 competition remains this intense, regulators may step in to standardize things. After all, multiple L2s have already been embroiled in data-falsification scandals. Capital flows may shift from chasing pure token price upside toward placing greater emphasis on compliance and more stable projects.

Most crypto traders do not lose money because they lack technical knowledge. They lose because they fail to manage their own minds. The market does not just test your charts—it tests your psychology every single minute.
Here are the four emotional traps that drain portfolios:
 * FOMO (Fear of Missing Out): A coin pumps 40%, green candles flood your feed, and you jump in near the top out of panic. Usually, that is right where early buyers take profit.
 * Greed: Your trade is in profit, but you refuse to close it because you want "just a little more." A quick reversal turns a winning trade into a loss.
 * Fear & Panic: The market dips, fear takes over, and you sell at the bottom just before the price recovers.
 * Impatience: Forcing trades during boring sideways markets instead of waiting for high-probability setups.
To stay profitable long-term, you must replace emotional reactions with clear rules:
 * Trade with a Plan: Define your entry level, target, and exit before you open any position. If the setup does not appear, stay on the sidelines.
 * Never Skip Stop-Loss: A stop-loss is not an admission of defeat; it is your portfolio's seatbelt. Decide your maximum risk per trade—ideally only 1% to 2% of your capital.
 * Master Waiting: In trading, doing nothing is often the smartest position. Cash is also a position. Wait for the market to come to your levels instead of chasing it.
Crypto will always remain volatile, but your decisions do not have to be. Protect your capital first, and the profits will follow naturally.

Sepolia Upgrade Enters Client Readiness Phase｜Validators Must Update Both Layers of Software｜ETH Near 2692—No Front-Running

My stance is to first see whether the testnet runs stably as planned, and only then to discuss the transaction outlook for a mainnet upgrade. The Ethereum Foundation’s Gl Amsterdam testnet announcement released on September 28 clearly states: Sepolia is scheduled to activate on October 6 at 13:53:36 UTC, while the dates for Hoodi and the mainnet are still undecided. This timing applies only to Sepolia; it cannot be written as if the ETH mainnet has already upgraded, nor can an old announcement be treated as a new positive catalyst for today.

What I’m paying special attention to this round is not the slogan of “whether fees will drop,” but execution risk. The official documentation lists the compatible consensus-layer and execution-layer client versions for Sepolia; validators also need to update both the Beacon Node and the Validator Client simultaneously. Since the upgrade includes separating the proposer and builder within the protocol, it also changes the block access list and part of the Gas pricing. Operators using external block-building infrastructure must verify their interfaces. Updating only one layer, or focusing only on the software’s major version while ignoring the release notes, may prevent you from keeping up with the new rules. The foundation also explicitly says that ordinary mainnet ETH holders need to do nothing based on this Sepolia announcement; the link it uses to “migrate coins and activate the upgrade” is something holders should be wary of.

Market transmission should be viewed in two steps: if Sepolia successfully activates and clients coordinate properly, it’s one of the necessary validations for the mainnet scheduling; it can reduce some implementation uncertainty. But passing the testnet does not mean the mainnet date has already been decided, and it does not guarantee that fees, throughput, or the ETH price will immediately show a measurable change. Conversely, if the testnet experiences a chain split, client compatibility issues, or delays, the market may first lower expectations for the upgrade. The foundation includes the relevant specifications in the bug bounty program—this is a risk discovery mechanism, not certification that “there are no vulnerabilities.”

When writing, Binance ETHUSDT is around $2,692. It’s down about 0.14% over 24 hours, with a high of $2,738.51 and a low of $2,667.94. Price is still in the middle of the range, so you can’t say this volatility is caused solely by the testnet event four days later. I see $2,668 as the short-term defensive line, and $2,710 to $2,739 as the upper validation zone. If price breaks below $2,668 and keeps failing to reclaim, the short-term pullback-and-hold assumption is invalidated. If it only pushes above $2,710 and then falls back, that also doesn’t count as confirmation.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t participate—I wouldn’t place a high-leverage bet on the upgrade. I would only consider a low-leverage spot “trend-following” long: enter with at most 1.2% of total funds only if the full hour closes above 2710, the next hour retests 2698 to 2710 while holding, and there are no new client incidents or official delays. At 2728 I’d cut the position in half; from 2738 to 2745 I would gradually close the remaining position in batches. If there is truly strong volume breaking the prior high, I’d keep only a very small tail position and move the stop-loss up. After entry, if there’s a hard stop below 2685, or if within one hour price closes back below 2698 leading to a complete exit, that’s the plan. If 2668 breaks first, the entry plan is cancelled directly. Testnet execution is a matter of technical and security progress—not a reason I must bet on in advance.

Source: Ethereum Foundation Gl Amsterdam Sepolia testnet announcement and EIP-7773 schedule; Binance ETHUSDT public market data. #ETH
The above is only personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

我的态度是先看测试网是否按计划稳定运行，再谈ETH主网升级的交易预期。以太坊基金会9月28日发布的Glamsterdam测试网公告明确：Sepolia计划在10月6日13:53:36 UTC激活，Hoodi和主网日期仍未决定。这个时间点只对应Sepolia，不能写成ETH主网已经升级，更不能把旧公告当成今天新增的利好。

这轮我特别关注的不是“会不会降费”口号，而是操作执行风险。官方列出了Sepolia兼容的共识层与执行层客户端版本；验证者还需要同时更新Beacon Node与Validator Client。由于升级把提议者与构建者分离纳入协议，也改变区块访问列表和部分Gas计价，使用外部构建基础设施的运营方还要核对接口。只更新一层、或只看软件大版本而忽略发布说明，可能无法跟随新规则。基金会也明确说普通主网ETH持有人无需因这份Sepolia公告做任何操作；借此要求持有人“迁币激活升级”的链接值得警惕。

对市场的传导要分两步看：Sepolia顺利激活与客户端协同，是未来主网排期的必要验证之一，能降低部分实施不确定性；但测试通过不等于主网已经决定日期，也不保证费用、吞吐或ETH价格立刻发生可量化变化。相反，若测试网出现链分叉、客户端兼容问题或延期，市场可能先压低升级预期。基金会把相关规范纳入漏洞赏金计划，是风险发现机制，不是“已经没有漏洞”的认证。

如果是我自己交易，目前不参与，不做高杠杆押升级。只考虑无杠杆现货顺势试多：完整一小时收上2710，下一小时回踩2698至2710守住，并且没有新的客户端事故或官方延期，才用总资金最多1.2%入场。到2728先减半，2738至2745分批平掉余仓；若真放量突破前高，只留极小尾仓并上移止损。入场后跌破2685硬止损，或一小时收回2698下全部平仓；若先破2668，计划直接取消。测试网执行是技术与安全进度，不是我必须提前下注的理由。

After BTC reclaims above 84K, many people instinctively focus only on direction: is it about to surge toward 85K again, and whether ETH and SOL should follow.

But in this kind of market, I care more about another thing: the moment you click, did your order actually get filled at the price you thought it would?

A sideways rebound is the easiest to mislead. On the chart it can look flat; the first couple of order book levels may already be thin. The quote may still be there—yet once your target size goes in, the actual fills will slip further back. You think it’s only a tiny spread difference, but once you account for slippage, fees, and the support/acceptance when exiting, the total cost of the whole order drifts.

There’s a harsh detail in trading: your directional judgment determines whether you want to act, while the quality of your order determines whether that trade feels comfortable. Especially when the market is just lifting upward out of the 82K–85K range, what matters isn’t whose button is faster—it’s which path has better depth, quote layers, fees, and trigger conditions suited to this particular order.

So when I look at Perp orders now, I don’t only ask “can it get filled?”—I first ask “is this fill clean?” That’s where an execution-focused perspective like PerpEX delivers value: assess the asset first, then consider different order environments, and only then decide which way this order should go.

#BTC #ETH

横盘反弹最容易骗人。图表看起来很平，盘口前两档可能已经薄了；报价看起来还在，目标数量一进去，实际成交会往后吃；你以为只是差一点点点差，最后算上滑点、费用和退出时的承接，整笔单的成本就漂了。

交易里有个很残酷的细节：方向判断决定你想不想做，订单质量决定这笔单舒不舒服。尤其是行情刚从 82K-85K 区间里往上抬的时候，真正要比较的不是谁的按钮更快，而是哪条路径的深度、报价层、费用和触发条件更适合这一单。

所以我现在看 Perp 单，不会只问“能不能成交”，而会先问“这单成交得干不干净”。PerpEX 这种执行比较视角，价值就在这里：先看资产，再看不同订单环境，最后再决定这一单往哪走。

这次下跌并非偶然，而是多重因素叠加的必然结果。根本原因在于，市场过于狂热地将AI概念简单等同于硬件需求，忽略了实际落地进度和盈利能力的鸿沟。就像去年疯狂抢矿机一样，现在投资者才发现，很多硬件供应商根本没拿到AI订单，只是靠概念融资，一旦资金链断裂或需求不及预期，泡沫就会破裂。这与2022年FANG股泡沫破裂的教训如出一辙——都发生在行业概念最被看好的时候。

对市场的影响主要体现在三个方面：首先，BTC和ETH作为避险和增值资产，短期内可能受益于避险情绪升温；其次，监管层可能会趁此机会收紧对科技硬件的过度融资行为；最后，资金会重新流向那些真正有AI应用场景且能产生利润的领域，比如芯片设计、算法服务。历史类似事件可以参考2019年5G概念泡沫破裂时，华为供应链的集体下跌。

操作思路
📉 看空科技硬件股的下跌逻辑短期有效，但意味着AI周期正在经历正常调整，不是行业末路。如果接下来美联储大幅降息或美国科技股出现全面反弹，这个判断作废。

📰 Why are miners starting to fear AI? Do OpenAI and Google’s remarks push crypto to pivot?

Researchers from OpenAI and DeepMind have collectively spoken out, warning that the pace of AI development may be too fast to control and calling for urgent legislation to rein it in. This move isn’t just talk—it's directly tying AI risks to the crypto market. Crypto miners, project teams, and investors all need to weigh this carefully: if AI really develops in this direction, the positions of major “older brothers” like Bitcoin and Ethereum could be shaken.

Why is this news important?
In short, the relationship between AI and cryptocurrencies has entered a new phase. Previously, people viewed AI as an application scenario. Now, AI itself has become a variable. When these two top AI companies publicly back up these messages, it’s essentially like giving the entire industry an “AI risk warning injection.” Why? Because AI is developing so quickly that it may have reached a stage where it can “outperform” human intelligence. In this context, algorithmic trading, AI compute mining, and other fields closely tied to crypto suddenly gain a massive new source of uncertainty. This implies:
1. Regulation may fully step into the AI space, and by extension regulate crypto as well
2. The competitive advantage of AI compute mining could be diluted
3. Algorithmic trading models could fail across the board

Market impact
The impact on BTC and ETH is direct and far-reaching. In the short term, sentiment may drop first, because AI stocks that everyone dared to hype (e.g., NVDA, BABA) get smashed, and capital will look for a safe harbor. But in the long term, is it true that the stronger AI gets, the weaker crypto becomes? Maybe not. Why?
- The shared consensus value of BTC and ETH is “digital gold/oil,” and AI development needs them as underlying tools—this demand is rigid
- The more severe the AI risks, the more the irreplaceability of decentralized networks stands out
- AI regulation that benefits transparent blockchain pathways is actually unfavorable to centralized platforms

Reference from history—similar events? In 2018, algorithmic trading accounted for 80% of U.S. retail trading volume, and when regulation came in, it crashed immediately. AI is currently in the eve of an explosion, and the crypto market may have to experience something similar—an almost silent evaporation.

Trading/operation strategy
💡 If AI risks erupt, a high probability event is that $BTC breaks below the psychological level of $80K—but the premise is that the proportion of overall compute contributed by algorithmic trading and AI compute mining exceeds 15%. If the Federal Reserve suddenly hikes rates by 50BP, this judgment becomes invalid.

以太坊市场深度分析：机构看好三千美元目标，鲸鱼持续增持释放积极信号

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二日凌晨，以太坊现货报价两千七百零五点四二美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点七九。从小时级别K线观察，价格在最近五个交易时段内围绕两千七百美元整数关口反复震荡，日内最低触及两千六百八十九点四七美元，最高上探至两千七百零九点四零美元，整体波动幅度约二十美元，呈现出典型的窄幅蓄势形态。

成交量方面，最近两个小时的成交额分别为七百一十六万美元和六百七十六万美元，较前两小时的约一千四百万美元明显萎缩，表明市场在当前位置观望情绪浓厚，等待新的催化剂打破平衡。从日线级别来看，以太坊在第三季度跟随大盘实现了可观涨幅，但与比特币相比仍显弱势，市场期待以太坊能够走出独立的补涨行情。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线报两千七百零一点零三，二十五周期均线报两千六百九十六点六零，九十九周期均线报两千六百八十五点五三，三线呈现多头排列，价格运行在所有均线上方，短期趋势偏多。特别值得关注的是，价格已经有效突破七周期和二十五周期指数移动均线，分别位于两千六百九十九点八五和两千六百九十五点四二，形成了技术面上的看涨确认。

MACD指标表现亮眼，快线数值为三点零四，慢线为二点一八，柱状图为正零点八七。柱状图连续扩大，显示多头动能正在加速释放。这是近期以太坊技术面最为积极的信号之一，暗示价格可能正在酝酿一轮上攻行情。

RSI六周期报五十九点零六，RSI十二周期报五十五点一八，处于中性区域，既没有超买也没有超卖，为后续上行保留了充足空间。KDJ指标中K线六十八点七九，D线六十二点三五，J线八十一点六七，J线处于相对高位但未极端，仍有继续走强的可能。随机RSI指标飙升至九十二点二二，已经接近超买区域，短期需关注是否会出现高位回落。

布林带上轨位于两千七百一十八点三五，中轨位于两千六百九十七点四六，下轨位于两千六百七十六点五八。价格运行在布林带中上方区域，接近上轨但未触及，上行空间约十三美元。ATR十四周期报十六点二七，波动率持续收窄，通常预示着即将出现方向性突破。

抛物线SAR指标报两千六百七十七点八八，远低于当前价格，维持稳定的看多信号。超级趋势线位于两千六百七十三点六五，同样位于价格下方提供支撑。

从综合量化因子来看，十五个因子中七个做多、七个做空、一个中性，多空力量完全均衡。综合指标当前给出短线偏空信号，历史胜率为百分之六十五点一二。相比比特币的模型信号，以太坊当前的多空分歧更大，方向选择更为关键。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的最大利好来自机构层面的坚定看好。花旗银行将以太坊十二个月目标价从两千两百四十美元大幅上调至三千零二十八美元，涨幅超过百分之三十五，这一目标价意味着从当前价位还有约百分之十二的上行空间。机构普遍看好以太坊在ETF资金流入、Layer2生态扩展以及质押收益吸引力提升等多重因素驱动下的中长期表现。

链上数据方面，大型持有者过去一周累计增持约六万枚以太坊，显示鲸鱼群体对当前价位的认可度较高。尾盘时段出现超过一千三百万美元的大额资金流入，进一步印证了机构资金的持续进场意愿。然而需要警惕的是，一位以太坊早期联合创始人关联钱包近期向新地址转移了十三万三千二百九十八枚以太坊，价值约三点五六亿美元，虽然可能只是钱包整理操作，但市场担忧存在潜在抛售风险。

ETF资金流向方面，以太坊ETF产品近期连续录得净流出，分别为负五千九百六十万美元和负一千八百九十万美元，显示机构在以太坊上的配置热情暂时低于比特币。这一现象与以太坊相对弱势的价格表现相互印证。

生态层面，英国金融行为监管局正式开放加密授权通道，要求所有在英运营的加密公司在二零二七年二月前完成申请，这将为包括以太坊在内的加密资产提供更清晰的监管框架。代币化股票在二零二六年增长百分之三百九十，虽然目前仅占全球股市的万分之零点二九，但预计到二零三零年将达到三千四百九十亿美元规模，以太坊作为代币化资产的主要承载平台将直接受益。

综合来看，以太坊短期处于窄幅蓄势阶段，技术面MACD动能扩张、均线多头排列、鲸鱼持续增持均释放积极信号。但ETF资金流出、 dormant whale潜在抛压以及随机RSI接近超买区域构成短期风险。关键关注两千七百一十八美元布林带上轨的突破情况，若成功突破则有望挑战两千八百美元整数关口；下方支撑关注两千六百七十七美元SAR位置以及两千六百五十美元心理关口。建议投资者保持耐心，等待方向明确后再做决策。

The zkAPI co-developed by the Ethereum Foundation and the open-source anonymous project Open Anonymity has been deployed on the Ethereum mainnet. Co-founder <$ETH > Vitalik Buterin took part in this development.

This protocol uses zero-knowledge proofs to separate payments from identity. Users first deposit assets such as $ETH, $USDC  into an on-chain vault contract in one lump sum. Then, when calling the AI interface, the service provider can see the request content but cannot see who the payer is. The payer only sees the spending amount and cannot link it to any specific request or any particular user.

Mechanically, the proof is generated locally on the user’s device to verify that the funds are sufficient to cover the current consumption and that they have not been previously used. After the server verifies it, the server issues a temporary key that has an upper spending limit and an expiration time.

On the path of paying to call an AI model, identity and payment are split into two separate things.

#ETH

📰 Why is the UK going crazy building data centers? AI sovereignty isn’t just something you can casually claim

A UK minister has just said that to avoid being choked by others using AI, the country must urgently build data centers. This isn’t a small-scale move. AI training needs massive amounts of electricity and servers. The UK doesn’t have enough servers right now and still has to rely on the US and Asia for supply—so how is that supposed to work? The minister’s meaning is very clear: data processing power must be firmly under its own control.

Why is this news important?
The UK is betting on the future of the AI race. AI is the absolute hot trend for the next five years—whoever gets compute power up first can take the lead in next-generation technology. The UK wants to take a differentiated approach: it doesn’t want to build chips like the US does, but instead focuses on data services. Behind this is the fear of being squeezed between China and the US. In plain terms, this is geopolitics expanding into the digital domain.

Impact on the market
In the short term, it may boost European data center stocks conceptually, but for Bitcoin and Ethereum? The impact is likely minimal. 1. 监管从“限制”转向“赋能”，比如美国若通过类似 Kalshi 的衍生品监管框架，能让数字资产首次实现规模化、机构化流转；
2. 技术迭代为场景铺设了基础，隐私计算、互操作性协议等突破能打破应用孤岛；
3. 机构资金入场的前提是“玩法多样”——既能做交易又能做 DeFi、又能用于合规支付，三者缺一不可。

这番言论与近期美国财长耶伦的“数字美元计划”形成共振，暗示全球主要经济体都在为数字资产产业“铺轨道”。对比 2017 年那波泡沫，彼时只有价格狂欢，而如今 Saylor 提供的框架包含了金融科技（FinTech）的维度，这或许是区别于前几轮炒作的关键。

📰 Just said XRP would go on Nasdaq, and now shareholders vote and pass again: what does this deal really mean for the crypto market?

Evernorth’s shareholders have approved the XRP custody merger plan, which means $473 million worth of XRP will be brought closer to a Nasdaq listing. The decision combines cash financing and token contributions and is a key step in the company’s plan to trade on Nasdaq (ticker: XRPN). For crypto investors, this could be another window of opportunity to access XRP through the mainstream stock market.

Why is this news important?
Evernorth’s successful vote matters first because it represents a breakthrough for the crypto industry within the traditional financial system. In recent years, although Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have been approved, XRP—despite being the third-largest cryptocurrency by market cap—has remained difficult to reach the U.S. retail investor spotlight through conventional channels. If Evernorth’s proposal ultimately goes through, it would break that status quo—not through an IPO, but in the form of “token depositary receipts” (TDRs), packaging XRP into shares that can be traded on Nasdaq.

What does this mean? First, it could change the landscape of major global exchanges. South Korea is one of the most active crypto trading markets in the world; if Evernorth succeeds, local Korean capital could indirectly allocate to XRP through Evernorth shares, reducing sell-pressure directly on exchanges like Binance and OKX. The transmission pathway depends on scale: if $473 million in XRP absorbed into Nasdaq index stocks via TDRs effectively adds potential incremental capital equivalent to about $500 million in market value—based on the current XRP price, that corresponds to a demand buffer of roughly 300 million XRP tokens injected into the market. Second, it could prompt regulators to reassess. If XRP can circulate legally and compliantly through traditional exchanges in this form, the likelihood of the U.S. approving an XRP ETF in the future may increase.

Market impact
In the short term, this news may have limited direct impact on BTC and ETH. Both BTC and ETH are consolidating within their respective ranges, and in the near term they are more influenced by macro factors such as Fed policy and U.S. PMI data. But in the medium term, if the Evernorth project progresses smoothly, it will validate the feasibility of crypto assets circulating through traditional financial channels and could boost confidence across the sector. By historical analogy: after the 2008 financial crisis, Bitcoin entered the U.S. retail market via OTC channels, and then more recently Ethereum ETFs were approved—these were gradual processes. Evernorth’s Nasdaq plan is more like an accelerated version of that trajectory.

Trading approach
The significance of this event to the crypto market lies more in structural opportunities than in a direct short-term price catalyst. 💡 For XRP-related investors, this is a structural catalyst. If it can move forward smoothly, it could accelerate the process of tokenizing XRP. However, this conclusion could be invalidated if the U.S. SEC suddenly introduces stricter compliance requirements, or if Nasdaq’s trading rules ultimately impose limitations on crypto assets. At present, if Nasdaq’s TDR plan can be executed according to the agreed framework, it will help increase global acceptance of traditional-finance pathways for crypto assets—but the direct impact on BTC and ETH may show up mainly in expectations for incremental capital. If XRP performs well on Nasdaq (daily trading volume over 10 million shares), it may indirectly lift overall sector sentiment.

📰 刚说XRP要上纳斯达克，现在股东投票又通过：这笔交易到底对加密市场意味着什么？

Evernorth公司股东投票通过了XRP库合并方案，这意味着价值4.73亿美元的XRP将更接近纳斯达克上市。这个决定结合了现金融资和代币贡献，是该公司计划在纳斯达克挂牌交易（股票代码XRPN）的关键一步。对于加密货币投资者来说，这可能是通过常规股票市场接触XRP的又一个机会窗口。

为什么这条新闻重要？
Evernorth的这次成功投票重要，首先是因为它代表了加密行业在传统金融体系内取得的一点突破。过去几年，虽然有比特币和以太坊ETF获批，但XRP作为市值第三大的加密货币，一直难以通过常规途径进入美国散户投资者视野。Evernorth的方案如果最终落地，将打破这种局面——不是通过IPO，而是以"代币存托凭证"（TDR）的形式，将XRP包装成可以在纳斯达克交易的股票。

这意味着什么？第一，它可能改变全球主要交易所的格局。目前韩国是全球最活跃的加密货币交易市场之一，如果Evernorth成功，韩国本土资金可能会通过Evernorth股票间接配置XRP，从而减少直接在币安、OKX等交易所的抛压。具体传导路径看规模：如果4.73亿美元XRP通过TDR形式被纳指股票吸收，相当于增加了相当于5亿美元市值的潜在增量资金，按当前XRP价格计算，相当于给市场注入了3亿枚XRP的需求缓冲。第二，它可能引发监管机构的重新评估。如果XRP能通过这种形式合法合规地在传统交易所流通，未来美国批准XRP ETF的可能性会增加。

对市场的影响
短期内，这条新闻对BTC和ETH的直接影响可能有限。目前BTC和ETH都在各自区间内整理，短期内更受美联储政策、美国PMI数据等宏观因素影响。但从中期看，如果Evernorth项目顺利推进，它将验证加密资产通过传统金融渠道流通的可行性，可能提振整个板块的信心。从历史类比看，2008年金融危机后，比特币通过OTC商进入美国零售市场，再到近期以太坊ETF获批，都是渐进式的过程。Evernorth的纳斯达克计划更像是这个进程中的加速版。

操作思路
这个事件对加密市场的意义更多在于结构性机会，而非直接的短期价格催化剂。💡 对于XRP相关投资者来说，这是一个结构性催化剂。如果能顺利推进，意味着XRP资产化进程可能加速。但这个判断如果美国SEC突然提出更严格的合规要求，或者纳斯达克交易规则最终对加密资产有限制，这个判断作废。当前来看，如果纳斯达克TDR计划能按既定方案执行，它将推动全球对加密资产传统金融路径的接受度提升，但对BTC和ETH的直接影响可能体现在增量资金预期上。如果XRP在纳斯达克的表现良好（日交易量超1000万股），可能间接带动整个板块情绪。

一、以太坊市场走势分析

截至北京时间十月二日凌晨六点，以太坊现货价格报二千七百零二美元，过去二十四小时微涨约百分之零点二四。从小时K线来看，价格在二千六百八十九美元至二千七百零六美元之间窄幅波动，整体维持在短期均线上方。最近五根小时K线显示，价格在触及二千六百八十九美元的日内低点后反弹至二千七百零三美元附近，说明二千六百九十美元一线存在较强的买盘支撑。

从均线系统来看，七日移动平均线报二千六百九十九点八六美元，二十五日均线报二千六百九十五点六七美元，九十九日均线报二千六百八十五点二八美元，三条均线呈现多头排列，价格位于所有均线之上。指数移动平均线同样确认多头格局，七日指数均线报二千六百九十八点六一美元，二十五日指数均线报二千六百九十五点零三美元，短期趋势偏多但上行力度较为温和。

二、技术指标解读

布林带方面，上轨报二千七百一十八点二三美元，中轨报二千六百九十七点三八美元，下轨报二千六百七十六点五四美元，价格运行在中轨与上轨之间的区域，带宽持续收窄，显示市场波动率降低，可能正在积蓄新的突破动能。MACD指标显示快线报二点三六，慢线报一点八八，柱状图为正零点四八，MACD在零轴上方运行且柱状图由负转正并持续扩大，显示多头动能正在逐步恢复。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI报五十六点七七，十二周期RSI报五十三点九零，二十四周期RSI报五十二点四零，各周期RSI均在五十附近徘徊，处于中性区域，既没有超买也没有超卖，表明市场方向尚待明确。KDJ指标显示K值六十二点九零，D值五十七点七八，J值七十三点一三，K线向上穿越D线形成金叉，J值向上发散，短期有偏多信号。抛物线SAR报二千六百七十七点一三美元，位于价格下方，维持看多信号。超级趋势线报二千六百七十三点六五美元，同样在价格下方提供支撑。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前的市场情绪呈现中性偏多的格局。花旗银行将以太坊十二个月目标价从二千二百四十美元大幅上调至三千零二十八美元，这一乐观预期为市场提供了心理支撑。以太坊生态方面，原生OUSD稳定币的推出吸引了超过十亿美元的初始流动性承诺，进一步丰富了以太坊的DeFi生态。

不过，风险因素同样值得关注。二零一五年ICO时期的一位早期参与者近期转移了十三万三千二百九十八枚以太坊，价值约三亿五千六百万美元，这一大额转账引发了市场对潜在抛压的担忧。此外，近期网络安全事件频发，九月份加密行业遭受了七点六八亿美元的损失，.validator退出队列中的预防性提款也可能带来短期的卖压。从资金流向来看，近期小时级别的净流出不明显，但大单买入达到三千五百八十万美元，显示有资金在低位承接。综合来看，以太坊在二千七百美元附近整理，短期方向有待突破布林带上轨二千七百一十八美元确认。

$ETH  two long-positive candles; trading volume has dropped to only two tenths of the average.

This chart is interesting. The price climbed with two consecutive candles, but volume shrank to the lowest tier within 30 K-lines. The volume ratio is 0.22, suggesting the bears have temporarily stopped pressing, but the bulls also haven’t really taken control. A breakout with shrinking volume is one of the most patience-testing ways of moving.

From the signals on the chart: the support at 2663 has been tested three times and failed to break. On September 30 at 16:00 and 20:00, and on October 1 at 00:00, price tapped this level three times and was taken up each time. The resistance level is 2738. It was touched twice on September 29 at 12:00 and September 30 at 12:00, and both times price fell back; only once it didn’t hold. The current price at 2702 sits right in the middle between support and resistance. In the past 24 hours, the high was 2721 and the low was 2671, with an amplitude under 2%. This is a classic sideways consolidation pattern, where big moves don’t happen on either side—waiting for a catalyst.

Market sentiment-wise: the funding rate is +0.0051%. Bulls are paying, but very lightly. This rate indicates there’s no clear directional bet in the market; both bulls and bears are watching. The 24h trading value is $8.68 billion, which isn’t large for an asset volume like ETH. When both the funding and the trading volume shrink at the same time, it’s usually a signal before a change of regime. The last time a similar combination appeared was between September 27 at 20:00 and 28 at 00:00; immediately afterward, the market dumped down to 2634. After this volume contraction, whether the next move is up or down depends on how capital chooses its direction.

There are hints of what big players are doing. On September 28 at 12:00, one 4h candle released $2.94 billion of volume. On September 30 at 12:00 it was $4.46 billion, and on October 1 at 12:00 it was $2.54 billion. Every other day around the midday window, there’s a wave of large orders entering to probe. Someone repeatedly uses capital to test the overhead resistance, but never commits to a decisive breakout. This pattern is something many times seen before: after probing the third or fourth time, it’s often when the real breakout happens. But it could also be a failed probe followed by a direct sell-off—the key is where the next midday K-line closes.

In terms of volume-price structure: from 2634 to 2705, price rose 2.7% while volume decreased step by step. On September 29 at 12:00 it was $3.0 billion; on September 30 at 12:00 it was $4.46 billion; on October 1 at 12:00 it was $2.54 billion. The most recent two 4h candles were only $1.64 billion and $0.35 billion. Price rising with contracting volume means either bulls are reluctant to sell at higher levels (not willing to chase at the highs), or there isn’t enough bullish chasing desire. Based on the K-line body characteristics, it leans more toward the second explanation. If the next wave brings increased volume and can hold above 2720, the trend is likely to reverse. If volume can’t expand, that’s a signal of a false breakout.

K-line details are worth a close look. On October 1 at 08:00: the candle opened at 2675, the low was 2671, and it closed at 2705. The lower shadow was only $4, and the body was a solid 30 dollars—an ideal bullish engulfing shape. Immediately after, at 12:00 that candle gapped up to 2705, surged to a high of 2710, but then closed at 2681. The upper shadow pressed down with 29 dollars, and the body was a bearish candle. The bulls tested the 2710 area once, but didn’t manage to hold; the bears pushed it back. At 16:00 they tried again, and it closed at 2699. Three attempts to push into the 2710–2720 range, and each time it pulled back. The bulls seem a bit impatient, but they couldn’t break through.

As the base-layer asset for smart contracts, ETH is the foundation for DeFi, NFTs, and Layer2. The on-chain ecosystem fundamentals haven’t changed. What happens next on the chart depends on when capital chooses a direction: as long as 2663 holds, bulls have confidence; a break above 2738 would be the start of a new leg of activity.

Nini’s plan: current price is 2702, with a mildly bullish mindset. If shrinking volume fails to break below 2663, hold. If a breakout above 2720 comes with rising volume, add to your position. The target is 2750. If it breaks below 2660, cut loss without hesitation. For short-term trading, it’s mainly about range-bound moves—don’t chase the price higher.

这盘面有意思。价格往上爬了两根，量却缩到30根K线里最低档。量比0.22，说明空头暂时不打了，但多头也没真发力。缩量上涨，最考验耐心的一种走法。

盘面信号看，支撑2663已经三次下探不破，9月30号16点、20点，10月1号00点，三次踩到这个位置都被接住。压力位2738，9月29号12点和30号12点两次摸到就回落，一次没站住。当前价2702正好卡在支撑和压力的正中间。24h最高2721最低2671，振幅不到2%。典型的横盘蓄力格局，上下都不出大动作，等一个催化剂。

市场情绪方面，资金费率+0.0051%，多头付费但极轻。这种费率说明市场没有明显的方向押注，多空双方都在观望。24h成交额86.8亿美元，对ETH这个体量来说不算大。费率和成交同时缩量，通常是变盘前的信号。上一次出现类似的组合是9月27号20点到28号00点之间，紧接着就砸了一波到2634。这次缩量之后是向上还是向下，得看资金怎么选方向。

大户动向有迹可循。9月28号12点那根4h放了29.4亿美元的量，9月30号12点44.6亿，10月1号12点25.4亿。每隔一天中午时段就有一波大单进场试探。有人在反复用资金试探上方压力，但每次都没下决心突破。这种模式见过很多次，试探到第三次第四次，往往就是真突破的时候。但也可能试探失败直接下杀，关键看下一次中午那根K线的收盘位置。

量价结构上，从2634反弹到2705，涨了2.7%，量能逐根递减。9月29号12点30亿，30号12点44.6亿，10月1号12点25.4亿，最近两根4h只有16.4亿和3.5亿。价涨量缩，要么是多头惜售不愿在高位追，要么就是追涨意愿不足。从K线实体看更偏后者。如果下一波放量能站稳2720以上，趋势大概率反转。缩量上不去，就是假突破的信号。

K线细节值得细看。10月1号08点那根，开盘2675最低2671，收盘2705，下影线只有4美金，实体饱满30美金，标准的多头吞没形态。紧接着12点那根高开2705，最高冲到2710，却收到2681，上影线压了29美金，实体是阴线。多头在2710附近试了一次，没站住，被空头打了回来。16点又试了一次，收盘2699。三次冲击2710-2720区间，每次都回落，多头有点急但打不穿。

ETH作为智能合约的底层资产，DeFi、NFT、Layer2全靠它，链上生态基本面没变。盘面走势就看资金什么时候选方向，2663不破多头就有底气，2738突破就是新一波行情。

妮妮的计划：当前价2702，偏多思路。缩量不破2663就拿着，放量突破2720可以加仓，目标看2750。跌破2660止损不犹豫。短线震荡为主，别追高。

The probability that the Federal Reserve will hold steady in October has already been raised to 64%. 

According to BlockBeats, citing the CME “Fed Watch,” the probability of keeping interest rates unchanged in October is 64%, while the probability of cumulative 25 basis points of rate hikes is 36%. By December, the probability of keeping interest rates unchanged is 11%, the probability of cumulative 25 basis points of rate hikes is 59.2%, and the probability of cumulative 50 basis points of rate hikes is 29.8%. The market’s interpretation is somewhat bearish for risk assets such as BTC and ETH, because the crypto market is highly sensitive to U.S. dollar liquidity and expectations for U.S. Treasury yields. The more cautious the interest-rate path is, the more likely capital will first press down the valuations of high-volatility assets.

This has very direct implications for the market: if expectations of “keeping rates high for longer” continue to prevail, highly volatile assets will typically face pressure first; if subsequent data weakens and rate-cut expectations rebound, risk-asset sentiment may loosen again. For traders, this isn’t a theme tied to a single token—it’s a macro pricing signal: if later employment and inflation data continue to support “keeping rates high for longer,” crypto rebounds will rely more on spot buying and ETF inflows as follow-through; if the data weakens, a rebound in rate-cut expectations may again provide a tailwind for major coins.

A more realistic observation is that traders will first watch changes in the October probabilities—or pay more attention to whether the December path remains tight?

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月二日凌晨，以太坊现货价格报二千七百美元附近，过去二十四小时微涨约百分之零点五四。从小时K线来看，ETH在过去五个小时内维持窄幅震荡格局，价格区间为二千六百九十三美元至二千七百一十四美元，波动幅度明显收窄。

与前几个小时的走势对比，以太坊在触及二千七百一十三美元的日内高点后未能有效突破，随后逐步回落。成交量从四千六百一十六万美元大幅缩减至七百八十一万美元，缩量整理特征明显。这种低波动低成交量的状态通常预示着即将迎来方向性突破。

从季度表现来看，以太坊在第三季度跟随大盘上涨，但涨幅明显落后于比特币。当前价格距离花旗银行给出的十二个月目标价三千零二十八美元仍有约百分之十二的上行空间，这为中长期投资者提供了一定的安全边际。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日均线报二千六百九十四美元，二十五日均线报二千六百九十四美元，九十九日均线报二千六百八十五美元。三条均线高度粘合，价格运行在均线集群上方，这是典型的蓄势形态。一旦价格有效突破均线集群上沿，可能引发趋势性行情。

布林带指标显示，上轨位于二千七百一十七美元，中轨位于二千六百九十六美元，下轨位于二千六百七十五美元。带宽极度收窄，上下轨间距仅约四十二美元，为近期最低水平。布林带收口通常是大行情启动前的信号，投资者需密切关注突破方向。

MACD指标方面，快线报一点六二，慢线报一点六七，柱状图为负零点零五五。MACD刚刚出现死叉信号，但柱状图绝对值极小，说明空头力量非常有限。如果价格能够维持在二千七百美元上方，MACD有望重新形成金叉。

RSI指标全面回落至中性区域。六周期RSI降至四十七点一零，已进入偏弱区域。十二周期RSI为四十九点七八，二十四周期RSI为五十点五二，均处于五十附近的中性水平。RSI的降温意味着短期超买压力已完全释放，为后续上涨腾出了空间。

KDJ指标显示K值五十四点八三，D值五十二点六五，J值五十九点一九。三线位于中性区域，K线在D线上方运行，维持弱多头格局。

量化因子统计显示，十五个因子中有十个发出做多信号，四个发出做空信号，一个中性。做多因子占比达到百分之六十六点七，明显高于比特币的多空均衡状态，说明以太坊的技术面多头信号更为一致。但综合指标仍给出短线偏空信号，历史胜率百分之七十，需要等待价格确认。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临的市场情绪较为复杂。利好方面，大型钱包在过去一周累计增持约六万枚ETH，机构资金的持续流入为价格提供了坚实支撑。花旗银行上调目标价至三千零二十八美元，进一步强化了市场对以太坊中长期价值的认可。

价格站稳在九十九周期EMA二千六百八十九美元上方，形成了有效的技术支撑。每当价格回踩该位置，都能获得稳定买盘的承接，显示市场对这一关键支撑位的共识较强。

风险方面，一个源自二零一五年ICO时代的古老钱包近期转移了十三万三千二百九十八枚ETH，市场担忧这些低成本筹码可能流入交易所形成抛压。此外，MetaMask正在退出Lido验证节点，这将启动为期四十五天的分阶段退出周期，可能对质押市场产生一定影响。

ETF资金面同样值得关注，以太坊现货ETF最新单日净流出五千九百六十万美元，虽然规模不大，但反映出机构资金在当前位置的犹豫态度。叠加美国国债收益率处于多年高位，风险资产整体承压。

综合来看，以太坊正处于关键的蓄势阶段。布林带极度收口、均线高度粘合、成交量萎缩，这些特征都指向即将到来的方向性选择。如果能够有效突破二千七百二十美元并伴随放量，则有望开启向三千美元进发的行情。反之，若跌破二千六百七十五美元，则可能回测二千六百日美元支撑。建议投资者密切关注成交量变化和资金流向，做好两手准备。

🚨 Why did MetaMask suddenly clear out 17,000 validators, with losses possibly as high as $50 million? What does this move really hint at?

MetaMask announced it would撤离大量 validators due to an ETH theft incident below $769.91. However, external reports say this action actually affected more than 5,000 validators, holding about 523,000 ETH (based on the current $2,694.75/ETH, worth $1.494.494M). MetaMask emphasized that users' funds are safe, but the potential impact is that validators may face downtime or miss rewards. This figure is far beyond the visible theft loss, implying there are deeper reasons behind the scenes.

Why is this news important?
There may be dual purposes behind this action. On the surface, the $769.91 theft is just the trigger, but MetaMask may actually be using “security drills” to remove inactive or inefficient validators. The amount of 5,000 ETH is comparable to large validators; their departure would reduce the total hashrate of the mainnet, which theoretically provides slight support to the price of ETH. More importantly, it shows that mainstream wallets’ concerns about validator operational risks are intensifying—if even a small loss exposes vulnerabilities, it could trigger a chain reaction.

Impact on the market
In the short term, MetaMask’s move will likely intensify market concerns about the fragility of the validator ecosystem, potentially causing some validators to passively exit due to liquidity pressure or confidence issues. The impact on the ETH price is limited, but it will weaken market confidence in the “decentralization” narrative. If more wallets follow suit, concentration of hashrate may increase, benefiting top validators. In the long run, this serves as a warning to regulators—the “centralization” risk of decentralized tools is becoming apparent.

Trading idea
💡 ETH has been ranging between $2,694.75 and $2,750 recently, and MetaMask’s action suggests that support below may be weak. If a wave of validator exits spreads to the top validators (for example, exit volume exceeds 10,000 ETH), the $2,694.75 support level could break, turning bearish in the short term. Holding $2,700 would mean panic sentiment eases, making the outlook neutral.

If, in the future, regulators are forced to require validators to disclose more operational details, MetaMask’s concerns would be invalidated, and the validator ecosystem could become healthier instead.

【Invalidation conditions】If, in the coming weeks, there is a large-scale wave of validators voluntarily exiting (e.g., exceeding $5,000 ETH in value), this view is void.

🚨 为什么 MetaMask 突然清仓17,000个验证者，损失可能高达5000万美元？这个动作到底在暗示什么？

MetaMask 宣布因一起低于 $769.91 的 ETH 偷窃事件而撤离大量验证者。但外界报告称，这次行动实际影响超过 5,000 个验证者，持有约 523,000 ETH（按当前 $2,694.75/ETH 计算，价值 $1.494.494M）。MetaMask 强调用户资金安全无虞，但潜在影响是验证者可能面临宕机、错过奖励。这个数字远超表面偷窃损失，意味着背后有更深层原因。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这次行动背后可能有双重目的。表面上，$769.91 偷窃只是导火索，但 Metamask 实际上可能通过“安全演练”淘汰不活跃或效率低下的验证者。5,000 ETH 持有量相当于大型验证者，他们的离开会减少主网上总算力，理论上对 ETH 价格产生微弱支撑。更重要的是，这显示主流钱包对验证者运营风险的担忧加剧——即使损失不大，暴露出漏洞也可能引发连锁反应。

对市场的影响
短期看，MetaMask 的行动会加剧加密市场对验证者生态脆弱性的担忧，可能导致部分验证者因流动性压力或信心问题被动退出。对 ETH 价格的影响有限，但会削弱市场对“去中心化”叙事的信心。如果更多钱包效仿，算力集中度可能上升，利好头部验证者。长期看，这为监管机构敲响警钟——去中心化工具的“中心化”风险正在显现。

操作思路
💡 ETH 近期在 $2,694.75-2,750 区间震荡，MetaMask 此举暗示下方支撑偏弱。如果验证者退出潮蔓延至头部验证者（如退出量超 10,000 ETH），$2,694.75 支撑位可能失守，短期看跌。守住 $2,700 则意味着恐慌情绪缓解，看平。

如果未来监管机构强制要求验证者披露更多运营细节，MetaMask 的担忧将落空，验证者生态反而可能更健康。

📰 Why is Strategy going crazy pulling STRC—are they trying to buy the dip in BTC?

Strategy, the firm behind the strategy, recently announced that it plans to aggressively pump STRC (a certain coin or token). The goal isn’t for them to profit themselves—it’s to use these tokens to exchange for even more BTC. Put simply, they want to use cheap chips to get Bitcoin. With Bitcoin currently hovering around $84,000, is this timing really that perfect?

Why is this news important?
First, you need to understand who Strategy is. They’re not a typical retail player; they’re an institution specialized in arbitraging between tokens and BTC. Doing this kind of move suggests that they believe STRC’s price is undervalued, while also being bullish on Bitcoin. Why does that matter? Because if STRC’s price truly rises due to Strategy’s buying, it could signal market recognition of the arbitrage opportunity between STRC and BTC—indirectly boosting confidence across the entire crypto market.

Impact on the market
The impact on BTC should be positive, since a player like Strategy pumping STRC is, in effect, pushing up the potential demand for Bitcoin. But keep in mind this is a typical short-term game. If BTC’s price really breaks above $85,000, STRC might not follow as expected—on the contrary, it could drop back because the arbitrage space gets compressed. Similar historical events involving cross-asset arbitrage by quant funds often ended up failing due to changes in market sentiment.

Trading thesis
💡 With Strategy aggressively pulling STRC at this point, I personally think there’s a 70% chance that, in the short term, it will help support BTC and keep it stable above $80,000. If STRC can hold above $1, BTC might be able to touch $86,000. But if U.S. inflation data comes in stronger than expected, this thesis is invalid. What do you think?

📰 Why does the Ethereum Foundation’s collaboration with Open Anonymity spark a privacy AI revolution?

The Ethereum Foundation and privacy-preserving organization Open Anonymity have partnered to launch a new technology called zkAPI. It enables users to completely hide their identity when interacting with AI, while still receiving high-quality services. This technology encrypts user data, returns answers directly after the AI completes its analysis, and exposes no personal information in between. This is a major piece of good news for all digital service users who need privacy protection, and it may also change how the AI industry obtains data.

Why is this news important?
At the core of zkAPI is zero-knowledge proof technology (zk-SNARKs), one of the most advanced privacy-preserving solutions available today. Previously, when using AI, users had to worry about data leakage. Now, with zkAPI, AI companies gain the information needed to analyze the data, yet cannot trace it back to the original content. Behind this are two key reasons: first, global data privacy regulations are tightening—GDPR in the EU is only the beginning; second, the higher the quality of training data for AI models, the more crucial it is to prevent users from turning the tables. This collaboration directly addresses the biggest trust bottleneck in the AI industry.

In terms of market impact, BTC and ETH may strengthen in the short term due to privacy-related hype, but the long-term effect is more critical. If enterprises adopt zkAPI at scale, it will significantly improve conversion rates for digital service users, because privacy is no longer a barrier to entry. This means the AI market in the coming years may become polarized: companies that adopt privacy solutions will see outsized growth, while those that stick to traditional data-collection methods will be marginalized. Historically, similar breakthrough technologies (such as HTTPS, HTTPS) have also reshaped industry dynamics.

Trading idea
Look for at least one wave of upside in ETH, since it directly benefits from the privacy technology breakthrough. It’s suggested to watch the key level at $2,703.34. If it can hold steadily, it indicates strong confidence in real-world deployment, and it may push toward $2,703.34. But be aware: if regulators suddenly tighten oversight of the combination of cryptocurrencies and AI, this view becomes invalid.

title: لماذا يجب مراقبة BTC/BNB/ETH؟
subTitle:
يجب مراقبة#BTC #bnb #ETH لأنهم أكبر وأهم العملات في سوق الكريبتو، ويؤثرون بشكل مباشر على اتجاه السوق ككل.
### 1. بيتكوين (BTC) – المعيار الأساسي للسوق
- هي أكبر عملة من حيث القيمة السوقية (حوالي 58-59% من هيمنة السوق حالياً)، وتُعتبر "الذهب الرقمي".
- تحركاتها تحدد مزاج السوق العام (Risk-on أو Risk-off). عندما يرتفع BTC غالباً ما يتبعه السوق، وعندما يهبط يضغط على معظم العملات البديلة.
- سيولة عالية جداً، وتدفقات مؤسسية كبيرة عبر صناديق ETF، واعتماد متزايد كأصل احتياطي.
### 2. إيثريوم (ETH) – قلب نظام العقود الذكية
- ثاني أكبر عملة، وهي المنصة الأساسية لـ DeFi وNFTs والتوكنة (Tokenization) والتطبيقات اللامركزية.
- مراقبة ETH تعطي إشارة عن صحة قطاع التطبيقات اللامركزية (TVL، الرسوم، نشاط الشبكة).
- نسبة ETH/BTC مهمة جداً لفهم ما إذا كانت السيولة تنتقل من البيتكوين إلى العملات البديلة أم لا.
### 3. بينانس كوين (BNB) – عملة أكبر منصة تداول + سلسلة BNB
- مرتبطة مباشرة بمنصة بينانس (أكبر بورصة في العالم من حيث الحجم)، وتُستخدم في خصومات الرسوم وLaunchpad وسلسلة BNB Smart Chain.
- تعكس نشاط التداول المركزي وصحة النظام البيئي لبينانس. أي أخبار أو تطورات تتعلق بالمنصة تؤثر عليها بقوة.
- من العملات الكبرى ذات السيولة العالية والاستخدام العملي اليومي.
### لماذا هذه الثلاثة تحديداً؟

translatedData.content:
Ethereum Foundation launches zkAPI｜Hiding payment linkage doesn’t mean hiding questions｜With ETH around 2700, I’ll first look at adoption

My stance is to acknowledge this as a practical privacy engineering breakthrough, but not to equate launching an application with ETH instantly getting another round of buy pressure. On October 1, the Ethereum Foundation’s official blog introduced zkAPI: users first deposit funds into the Ethereum mainnet treasury to obtain usage credits, then use zero-knowledge proofs to authorize a certain amount of API calls. The payment layer can verify “there are sufficient funds to pay,” without needing to know which deposit or identity corresponds. The project is carried out in collaboration with Open Anonymity, and the Foundation says it has been running on the mainnet; the open-source repository also publishes the client, protocol, and contracts.

This isn’t a full network-wide Ethereum privacy upgrade, and it hasn’t changed the public nature of ordinary ETH transfers.

The mechanism worth watching is separating invoices from the call content. The Foundation explains that under the short-term key mode at runtime, the payment server only checks the credit amount and the usage receipt, without touching the problem content. The model service provider will still see the prompt sent to it, but it won’t directly obtain the payment identity. There’s also a more easily deployable proxy mode, but the relay server can see traffic, so the privacy boundary is weaker.

More importantly, IP addresses, request time, and personal details embedded in prompts may still re-link a session. Therefore, “anonymous payments” absolutely does not mean “no one can see the questions,” and it certainly can’t be treated as a safety guarantee for casually uploading sensitive information like medical or financial data.

How might it impact the crypto market? If pay-per-use AI and data APIs truly can reduce the binding between identities and invoices, on-chain settlement would gain another concrete use case, potentially increasing demand for Ethereum treasuries, stablecoins, and infrastructure. But actual costs, number of independent users, repeat purchases, and contract security all still need to be verified. Technical feasibility and commercial scale are not the same thing, and the value of a single application doesn’t necessarily translate into an ETH price move. The market has also not provided direct attribution evidence: as of around 3:40 Beijing time, Binance’s ETH/USDT is about 2697, with rolling 24-hour high 2722 and low 2667.94—up slightly versus 24 hours ago. This change is influenced simultaneously by the broader market, interest rates, and spot capital; it can’t be claimed that it was caused directly by zkAPI’s release.

If I were trading myself, I wouldn’t participate right now—no chasing the application narrative, and no shorting. My watch level is whether it can hold above 2722; below that, I’m watching around 2668. I would only consider going long on spot if there’s a one-hour closing break above 2722, followed by a retest where 2710–2722 holds without breaking, and if the broader market and Foundation-related capital do not show clear weakening. If I do, I’d keep total funds to at most 1.5%, with no leverage. First target: 2760; once hit, I’ll cut the position in half and move the remaining stop-loss up to breakeven. Second target: 2800; fully close the remaining position. Initial stop-loss: 2690. If price drops below 2668 before entry, the plan will be canceled. After entry, if two consecutive hourly candles close back below 2710, I’ll also actively exit. If later the project is found to have major contract risks, or usage cannot detach from subsidies and the price loses 2668, my moderate observation would be invalidated and I’ll continue to hold cash.

We need to see real adoption for technological progress, and we need price confirmation for any trading plan.

#ETH
The above is only my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

以太坊基金会推出zkAPI｜隐去付款关联不等于隐去提问｜ETH在2700附近我先看采用

我的态度是承认这是实用的隐私工程进展，但不把一个应用上线等同于ETH立刻获得新一轮买盘。以太坊基金会10月1日官方博客介绍zkAPI：用户先向以太坊主网金库存入使用额度，再用零知识证明授权一定额度的API调用，让支付层验证“有足额资金可付”，却不必知道对应哪个存款或身份。项目由Open Anonymity与基金会合作完成，官方称已在主网运行；开源仓库也公开了客户端、协议和合约。它不是什么以太坊全网隐私升级，也没有改变所有普通ETH转账的公开性。

真正值得看的机制是把账单与调用内容拆开。基金会说明，运行时短期密钥模式下，支付服务器只核对额度和使用回执，不接触问题内容；模型服务商仍会看到发给它的提示词，却不直接获得付款身份。另有较易运行的代理模式，但中继服务器可以看到流量，隐私边界较弱。更重要的是，IP地址、请求时间、提示词里的个人细节仍可能重新把会话关联起来。因此“匿名支付”绝不等于“提问内容没人能看”，更不能当作医疗、财务等敏感信息随意上传的安全保证。

它为什么可能影响加密市场？如果按次计费的AI与数据API真能减少身份和账单的绑定，链上结算会多一个具体使用场景，可能增加对以太坊金库、稳定币和基础设施的需求；但实际费用、独立用户数、复购和合约安全都还需要验证。技术可运行与商业规模不是同一件事，单个应用的价值也不必然传导为ETH价格。当前市场也没有给出直接归因证据：截至北京时间约3:40，币安ETH/USDT约2697，滚动24小时高2722、低2667.94，较24小时前小幅上涨。这个变化同时受大盘、利率和现货资金影响，不能说就是zkAPI发布带来的。

如果是我自己交易，眼下不参与，不追应用叙事，也不做空。我的观察位是2722上方是否能站稳，往下是2668一带。只有一小时收盘突破2722、随后回踩2710—2722不破，而且大盘及基金资金没有明显转弱，我才考虑现货试多，总资金最多1.5%，不加杠杆。第一目标2760，达到后减半并把余仓止损抬至成本；第二目标2800，余仓全部平仓。初始止损2690；若入场前先跌破2668，计划取消。入场后连续两根小时线收回2710下方，也主动离场。若项目后续发现重大合约风险，或使用量不能脱离补贴而价格失守2668，我的温和观察判断被推翻，继续留现金。技术进展要看真实采用，交易计划更要看价格确认。

#ETH

OpenAI的ChatGPT和Grok系统能根据用户指令，在照片中移除穆斯林女性的头巾。这暴露了AI在处理宗教敏感性内容时的缺陷，引发全球范围内的伦理争议。该功能虽然看似无害，实则让算法成为执行文化偏见的新工具，直接冲击了科技公司在全球市场的道德信誉，对依赖AI服务的加密领域尤其构成警示。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这件事根本原因在于AI训练数据缺乏多样性，算法没有建立跨文化敏感性认知。当算法能轻易执行移除头巾、修改肤色等操作时，意味着AI系统正在无意识复制甚至放大现实社会的偏见。在加密行业，这种技术滥用风险尤为突出，因为DeFi、NFT等应用场景正深度介入金融、身份认证等敏感领域，算法偏见可能直接导致系统性歧视。

对市场的影响

title: 3层验证看懂链上异动，普通人还在被巨鲸转账带节奏？
subTitle:
如果你也是看见巨鲸转账就紧张、看到链上异动就想追，这套方法可以直接参考。（我也踩过这个坑。）

真正有用的不是“跟着聪明钱买”，而是用链上数据做三层验证，过滤掉大部分噪音。

第一层，看事件发生了什么。

观察 $ETH 巨鲸钱包持仓变化、连续转账，以及以太坊基金会转出等公开链上行为。重点不是单笔金额有多大，而是资金是否持续移动、流向哪里、后续有没有进入交易平台或链上协议。

钱包转账只能说明资产换了位置，不能直接等同于买入或卖出。先确认路径，再谈影响。

第二层，看市场处于什么位置。

分析 $BTC 周期时，可以把MVRV Z-Score与Supply-Adjusted CDD放在一起看。前者用于观察市场估值偏离，后者辅助判断沉睡筹码是否开始活跃。

单个指标触及某个区域，不适合直接当成顶部或底部结论。更实用的做法，是观察两个指标是否同步变化，再对照价格结构和成交表现。

第三层，看交易是否过度拥挤。

现货数据给出市场基础，永续合约持仓相关的衍生品偏离度，则用于观察杠杆情绪。如果价格上涨，但衍生品风险同步积累，继续追价需要更谨慎；如果链上数据和合约数据互相冲突，也应先等确认。

分析Uniswap新项目同样如此：发现链上资金流入只是第一步，还要检查流动性、交易活跃度和筹码变化，不能把“有人买”直接理解成“值得买”。

以后看盘时，按“链上事件—周期位置—杠杆风险”过一遍，再决定继续观察还是参与交易，往往比盯着一笔巨鲸转账更有用。

【SEC opens a new path for institutional crypto custody—don’t rush to turn it into a rule】

The U.S. SEC has released a new draft rule on crypto asset custody, covering registered investment advisers, investment companies, and business development companies.

The proposal has three key points:

• Establish a crypto asset custody framework for investment advisers and regulated funds
• Allow self-custody under certain conditions
• Permit state-level trust companies to serve as crypto asset custodians for clients and funds

The significance of this is not just “regulation becoming more friendly.” The real impact is: if the final rule keeps these designs, when traditional funds allocate to crypto assets, there may be clearer compliance pathways and more custody options.

But for now, it’s still only a proposal. The formal rule must go through a 60-day public comment period after being published in the Federal Register. Its content may change, and it does not mean the questions about whether all tokens qualify as securities have already been resolved.

Market reaction is somewhat positive, but it cannot be attributed entirely to this news. Around 11:33 (Taiwan time):

• $BTC  at about $85,200, up roughly 2.1% in the past 24 hours
• $ETH  at about $2,720, up roughly 1.3% in the past 24 hours

Next to watch:

• ETH holds above $2,725: there’s a chance the rebound could continue. If it drops back below $2,670, it would indicate the current breakout has failed.
• Tonight at 20:30 (U.S.) the Non-Farm Payrolls data may still outweigh the regulatory positive news and cause prices to be driven again by interest-rate expectations.

This is a step forward in regulatory infrastructure—not proof that rules have already been implemented, and not a guarantee that prices will necessarily rise.

Yes, to add a bit more— for example, with the same principal of 10,000: when you use 100x leverage with a 5% position size, the position size is 50,000. That effectively means 5x leverage on the principal.

Similarly, with 10x leverage and a 50% position size, the position size is also 50,000—again, that’s 5x leverage on the principal.

This 5x leverage is the leverage multiple that most people understand. It’s not the case that if the contract is set to 100x leverage, it is necessarily 100x leverage.

If you truly set 100x leverage, then after accounting for fees, funding, and liquidation costs, a 1% move in the market would trigger liquidation. Plugging in the numbers: if you buy at a market price of 2000 USD and the price is $ETH , then if it drops into the range of 1980–1985, it would lead to liquidation of the account funds of #eth  #trader

In addition, both Haitang and Buffett have done the same thing—going personally to conduct field research.

You’ll find that almost all the people who achieved big results couldn’t do it without repeatedly capturing periods of intense market volatility.

Teacher Fu says that risk comes from leverage, but that’s wrong. Risk doesn’t come from leverage—it comes from the size of your position.

A 150x leverage with a 10% position and a 50x leverage with a 30% position have the same notional value. It’s a simple math problem:

150×10=1500

【People who’ve been burned by wrapped tokens, how do they look at ETH now】

To be honest, my market-monitoring state right now is pretty subtle. It’s not the newbie mode where you’re just excited the moment you enter, and it’s not the dead-pig mode where you fully lie flat and do nothing. It’s more like—I've got a position in hand, my eyes are on the chart, and in my mind I'm weighing whether to move.

As for ETH right now, $ 2717 has been going sideways for almost a week. The price swings are only a few percentage points—like a half-dead patient. Between 2620 and 2776, it keeps wobbling within that couple-hundred range. Should it go up or down? I don’t know, but I do have my own logic.

First layer: Citi just adjusted its 12-month ETH target from $ 2240 to $ 3028. I never treat the institutional voice as scripture, but this kind of adjustment is itself a signal—at least it shows that someone is seriously watching this level. $ 2717 is still over 10% away from their target. Is it worth participating? Different people will answer differently, but at minimum it suggests this level hasn’t been completely abandoned by the market.

Second layer: The drawdown from the peak is 45%. In historical terms, what does that even mean? In the late stage of the 2017 bear market, ETH’s drop was roughly around the same magnitude. Long-term capital is starting to build positions slowly now, and that doesn’t surprise me. But building a position is one thing—institutions won’t “raise the sedan chair for you.” The time they take to grind the base is much longer than retail traders’ patience.

Third layer: the MetaMask matter. 523000 ETH exited verification. It looks like a big number, but if you think it through—are those ETH being put into a bank, or are they being dumped on the market? MetaMask itself said "no funds at risk." In plain terms, it’s self-auditing and self-correction, not really trying to cause trouble. This news may have some short-term impact on sentiment, but the actual sell pressure isn’t as large as people imagine.

So how am I looking at it now? ➡️ Consolidation, slightly bullish.

Note: I said slightly bullish, not bullish. There’s a fundamental difference. Bullish is thinking it’s going up. Slightly bullish is thinking—it's not going to move much downward.

The only way this makes me admit I’m wrong is if: $ 2620 breaks. That would be the real weakness. At this level, as long as the volume doesn’t explode and smash it down, the odds of holding are higher than the odds of a breakdown.

What’s everyone’s mindset right now? If you already have a position, are you still willing to hold? If you have no position, do you dare to enter?

【被套怕了的人，现在怎么看ETH】

说实话，我现在盯盘的状态很微妙。不是那种刚进来就兴奋的新人模式，也不是完全躺平的死猪模式。就是——手里有仓位，眼睛盯着，心里盘算着要不要动。

现在的ETH，$ 2717，横了快一周了。涨跌幅都是一点几个点，像个半死不活的病人。2620到2776，这两百块的区间晃来晃去，你说它要往上还是往下？我不知道，但我有我的判断逻辑。

第一层，Citi刚把ETH的12个月目标从$ 2240调到$ 3028。机构的声音我向来不当圣旨，但这个调整本身是个信号——至少说明有人在认真看这个位置。$ 2717离他们的目标还有10%多的空间，值不值得参与？见仁见智，但至少说明这个位置不是完全被市场抛弃。

第二层，从高点跌了45%，这个回撤幅度在历史上是什么概念？2017年的熊市末期，ETH跌幅也差不多这个数。长线资金现在开始慢慢建仓，我不奇怪。只是建仓归建仓，机构不会给你抬轿子，他们磨底的时间比散户的耐心长得多。

第三层，MetaMask那事。523000 ETH退出了验证，看着数字大，但仔细想想——这些ETH退出来是存银行还是砸盘？MetaMask自己都说"no funds at risk"，说白了就是自查自纠，不是真的要搞事情。这消息短期情绪上有影响，但实际抛压没有想象中那么大。

那我现在怎么看？➡️震荡，偏强一点点。

注意，我说的是偏强，不是看涨。这两个有本质区别。看涨是觉得它要往上走，偏强是觉得——跌不太动。

真正让我认错的方式只有一个：$ 2620破了，那才是真的弱。现在这个位置，只要成交量不放量砸盘，撑住的概率比破位的概率大。

你们现在什么心态？手里有仓位的还敢不敢拿？没仓位的敢不敢进？

title: OUTUBRO 2026: QUAIS CRIPTOMOEDAS PODEM GANHAR DESTAQUE?
subTitle:
🚀 OUTUBRO 2026: QUAIS CRIPTOMOEDAS PODEM GANHAR DESTAQUE?

O mercado cripto começa outubro com alguns sinais importantes no radar dos investidores: recuperação do Bitcoin, retorno dos fluxos institucionais e vários eventos de desenvolvimento em grandes redes.

Mas atenção: catalisador não significa garantia de alta. O mercado continua sujeito a juros, liquidez, realização de lucros e mudanças no cenário macroeconômico.

🔎 BTC — Bitcoin

O Bitcoin entra em outubro com um fator histórico interessante.

Nos últimos 13 anos, o BTC terminou outubro em alta em 10 ocasiões. Além disso, os ETFs spot de Bitcoin nos EUA registraram aproximadamente US$ 2,4 bilhões em entradas na semana encerrada em 25 de setembro.

📌 O que observar:
• Fluxos dos ETFs
• Manutenção da tendência de alta
• Volume negociado
• Resistências próximas
• Política monetária dos EUA

⚠️ Sazonalidade histórica não garante repetição.

🟣 ETH — Ethereum

O Ethereum possui um importante catalisador técnico em outubro.

O upgrade Glamsterdam está programado para entrar na rede de testes Sepolia em 6 de outubro. A atualização faz parte do plano de evolução da escalabilidade do Ethereum.

📌 O que observar:
• Desenvolvimento do Glamsterdam
• Fluxos dos ETFs de ETH
• Atividade da rede
• Evolução da demanda institucional

🟢 SOL — Solana

A Solana também entra no radar.

O projeto Alpenglow pretende melhorar significativamente a velocidade de finalização das transações, com objetivo de aproximadamente 150 milissegundos.

Além disso, a SOL apresentou forte recuperação desde a mínima registrada em junho.

📌 O que observar:
• Evolução do Alpenglow
• Atividade da rede
• Fluxos de produtos relacionados à SOL
• Volume e força relativa

🔵 LINK — Chainlink

A narrativa de tokenização de ativos continua ganhando espaço.

Em setembro, a Chainlink apresentou o CCIP 2.0, trazendo novos recursos para comunicação entre blockchains, verificação e compliance.

📌 O que observar:
• Adoção institucional
• Tokenização de ativos
• Expansão do CCIP
• Crescimento do ecossistema

💠 XRP

O XRP também merece atenção em outubro devido à combinação de produtos institucionais e atualizações do XRP Ledger.

📌 O que observar:
• Fluxos de produtos negociados em bolsa
• Atualizações do XRPL
• Adoção institucional
• Volume e volatilidade

📊 MINHA LISTA DE ATIVOS PARA ACOMPANHAR EM OUTUBRO:

🔥 O ponto mais interessante é que cada ativo possui uma narrativa diferente:

BTC → fluxo institucional + sazonalidade
ETH → atualização Glamsterdam
SOL → Alpenglow + crescimento do ecossistema
LINK → tokenização + infraestrutura cross-chain
XRP → adoção institucional + evolução do XRPL

After BTC is back above 84K, the most easily overlooked thing isn’t the direction—it’s the order quality in those few seconds before you place the order.

When many people see the price move, their first reaction is to chase: how wide is the spread right now? Are the first couple of order-book depth levels enough? Will the target amount eat into the third or fourth layer? If you need to exit, has the opposite-side liquidity thinned out?

If you don’t check these, the 84,900 on your screen and the execution average price you ultimately get may have nothing to do with each other. Especially during early-session rebounds, around data releases, and when popular coins are jumping at the same time, the quote layers are often more honest than the candlestick chart.

I’d rather break the pre-order check into four steps: first look at the spread, then check the depth, then estimate the execution deviation, and finally compare the fees and trigger conditions across different routes. Direction judgment answers whether you want to do it; order quality tells you whether this trade is actually worth doing right now.

The value of execution-focused tools like PerpEX isn’t about telling you the direction. It’s about reminding you that for the same coin, at the same moment, but under different order environments, the results can differ in a very real way.

【Catching the ETH dip isn’t really about buying the price】

I sold ETH back in 2017 when it was around 300 yuan, and I also sold it in 2021 when it hit around 4,000 yuan. It wasn’t because I nailed the timing—it’s because I’m always looking for a “reason for the drop to play out.” Now the price has been hovering around 2,700. In the past 24 hours it’s up 1%, and in the past 7 days it’s up 0.9%. Sounds nice as “consolidation,” but if we’re being honest, it’s just the direction being held back.

Citigroup just adjusted its 12-month ETH target from 2,240 to 3,028. I’m not saying you should follow their call for trading, but I noticed something: institutions raising their targets isn’t just guesswork—it’s the ETF inflow data talking. What are smart money players doing? Not hard to figure out.

But today I want to talk about something other than price.

Two days ago, MetaMask had a security incident. ETH validators were forced to exit passively, involving roughly 520,000 ETH staked. What happened then? The price didn’t crash, and there wasn’t a major issue on-chain. So what does that mean? It means the Ethereum base-layer infrastructure’s fault tolerance is on a completely different level compared to three years ago. Back then, if something like this happened, it would have already triggered a waterfall sell-off. Now everyone’s first reaction is: “Check it, make sure it’s fine, then carry on.” This isn’t retail buying—it’s a sign of ecosystem maturity.

Ethereum is now down 45% from its historical highs. I’m not here to call for catching the dip, but in 2018 I saw the same kind of scenario—BTC fell 80%, ETH fell 90%, and everyone said consensus was gone. Then what happened? DeFi came, NFTs came, institutions came, and ETFs came. Once the technical ecosystem is rooted, how deep the pullback is matters less; what matters is whether there are people still building on top of it.

From a business logic perspective, Ethereum is currently the only truly smart-contract chain with a real developer ecosystem, real TVL, and actual settlement demand. Layer2 solutions have pushed fees down, institutions have entered, and the RWA narrative is starting to land. Can this actually run in the real world? Of course it can—the on-chain data is right there.

So the question is: after this round of consolidation, are you the person watching for direction, or the person who only reacts after the direction becomes clear?

In the 10-year US Treasury, intraday yields touched 5.3%, but at the close it swallowed all the PCE tailwinds.

On the Crypto side: 30-year US Treasuries are nearing 5.6%, yet BTC keeps marching from 71K to 84K—this “rubber band” logic has stayed in play all year. Things on-chain are even more interesting: a certain institution liquidated 172,500 ETH at the beginning of September, netting $124 million, then turned around to buy UNI. HyperLabs redeemed $375 million worth of HYPE, which will only land on 10/7.

The security situation isn’t calm: MetaMask Staking infrastructure was breached, prompting a precautionary exit from Lido validators. And Bitget’s stolen funds laundering chain is still running across chains.

In one sentence: technical momentum pushes forward, fiscal policy holds back, with a trust crisis wedged in between.

In January this year, I learned about the crypto industry. When I first entered, I lost half my funds because of scam coins. At that time, I placed orders purely based on emotions.

  Most important is controlling your position size, learning to stay out of the market, and waiting for opportunities. Don’t get carried away. If you lose on two or three trades, take a break.

🤔 Why does Aptos do time-difference matters in Thailand’s education market, and also focus on USDT efficiency?

Aptos and the Thai exchange Bitkub team up to turn USDT into their own native token, and they also specifically promote it through education in Thailand. In simple terms, it’s to make USDT more convenient and faster for Asian users—especially in the Thai market—potentially helping stablecoins become popular and boosting trading volume along the way.

Why is this news important?
The key is the timing and location Aptos chose—Thailand. Thailand is one of the countries in Asia with the greatest potential for digital currency markets, but users have long complained about USDT’s efficiency issues. Aptos is now directly empowering local exchanges, which is effectively like injecting liquidity into the Thai market. This isn’t just a straightforward technical integration—behind the scenes, Aptos is betting on a big opportunity in the Asian stablecoin market, especially the “juicy” part in Southeast Asia. Why? Because there are many young people in Southeast Asia and a strong willingness to use digital currencies, but localized services haven’t kept up. Aptos is filling that gap.

Market impact
For BTC/ETH prices, this is more like icing on the cake than a lifeline. BTC and ETH are both currently range-trading at high levels, so the short-term sentiment impact may be limited. But in the long run, if Aptos’s model can succeed in Thailand, it could drive more similar integrations to appear—benefiting the Asian stablecoin market and indirectly supporting the broader crypto ecosystem. In terms of regulation, the U.S. has approved a spot USDT ETF, which gives the entire stablecoin market a shot of confidence. Aptos’s move is perfectly timed with the policy tailwind. Where does the capital flow? Asia’s FOMO sentiment could be further stoked.

💡 I believe this is positive for the Asian stablecoin market. In the short term, it may drive regional exchange traffic. But the key is whether Aptos can continue to educate the market. If Thai users don’t buy in, or if faster solutions emerge later, the impact will fade. Hold the $2,700 ETH level and see if it can lift other Asian stablecoins too. If regulation suddenly tightens on USDT, then this logic falls apart.

Aptos 和泰国交易所 Bitkub 联手把 USDT 做成自家原生代币，还专门在泰国搞教育推广。简单说，就是为了让亚洲用户用 USDT 更方便、更快，尤其是泰国市场，可能让稳定币流行起来，交易量也跟着涨。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这事的关键在于 Aptos 选的时机和地点——泰国。泰国是亚洲数字货币市场潜力最大的国家之一，但 USDT 的效率问题一直让用户抱怨。Aptos 这下直接给本地交易所赋能，等于变相给泰国市场输血。这不是简单的技术整合，背后是看准了亚洲稳定币市场这块大蛋糕，特别是东南亚这块肥肉。为什么？因为东南亚年轻人多、用数字货币意愿强，但本地化服务跟不上，Aptos 填补了这块空白。

对市场的影响
对 BTC/ETH 价格来说，这属于锦上添花，不是雪中送炭。BTC 和 ETH 目前都在高位震荡，短期情绪受影响有限。但长期看，如果 Aptos 这个模式能在泰国成功，可能会带动更多类似整合出现，利好亚洲稳定币市场，间接支撑整个币圈生态。监管方面，美国批准了现货 USDT ETF，这给整个稳定币市场打了一针强心剂，Aptos 这步棋正好踩在政策东风上。资金流向？亚洲的 FOMO 情绪可能被进一步点燃。

💡 我认为这对亚洲稳定币市场是利好，短期内可能带动区域交易所流量。但关键看 Aptos 能否持续教育市场，如果泰国用户不买账，或者后续出现更快的解决方案，这个影响就没了。守住 $2,700 这个 ETH 位，看能否带动其他亚洲稳定币涨。如果监管突然收紧 USDT，这个逻辑就作废。

translatedData.title: EF throws zkAPI onto mainnet: pay for AI without revealing your identity
translatedData.subTitle:
Ethereum Foundation just pushed zkAPI to mainnet. The key point is simple: when you pay your AI bills, you don’t have to tie your identity, card, and every prompt into a single record anymore.

How it works:
1️⃣ Put credit into an Ethereum vault (with $ETH  / e.g. $USDC, etc.)
2️⃣ Local client uses zero-knowledge proofs to issue short-term, quota-limited API keys
3️⃣ Prompt goes directly to the model provider; the billing layer only sees spend, while the model provider only sees the content—things don’t line up to a person on either side

This is the rollout of Vitalik + EF dAI Lead Davide Crapis’s February "ZK API Usage Credits" suite, done together with Open Anonymity. The client is compatible with OpenAI/Ollama—existing tools can use it by pointing to localhost.
